raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in multi-modal reinforcement learning to advance next-generation intelligent systems. Your work will focus on optimizing decision-making and adaptive behavior across integrated data modalities such as text, images and audio to deliver enhanced intelligence, robust performance, and domain-specific capabilities for real-world challenges. You will develop and scale reinforcement learning techniques within complex multi-modal architectures, including diffusion-based generative models and autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, as well as resource-efficient models designed for constrained hardware environments. This includes conducting research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, spanning diffusion models for image autoregressive models for multimodal reasoning, and unified multimodal frameworks.

You are expected to have deep expertise in designing multi-modal reinforcement learning systems and a strong background in advanced model architectures, with a hands-on, research-driven approach to building and deploying novel algorithms and training frameworks. You will design and develop RL infrastructure and reward modeling strategies to enable efficient large-scale training, improve training stability, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes. Your responsibilities also include curating multi-modal simulation environments and training datasets, improving baseline policy performance across modalities, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in multi-modal learning and reward optimization. In addition, you will explore next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more directly and effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of unlocking superior, domain-adapted AI performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified frameworks that integrate multiple modalities.

  • Design and build reinforcement learning infrastructure that supports scalable, distributed training across multimodal systems while maintaining efficiency and reliability.

  • Develop and refine reward modeling strategies that improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create and curate multimodal simulation environments and datasets to support robust training, evaluation, and benchmarking of reinforcement learning systems.

  • Design and conduct rigorous benchmarking and evaluation protocols to measure model performance, track progress against baselines, and validate improvements across multimodal tasks.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate and develop next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of achieving superior state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

  • Publish research findings in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.

Requirements

  • A Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field is required; a PhD in Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, or a closely related discipline is preferred, along with a strong track record of AI research and publications in top-tier conferences.

  • Proven experience running large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online RL settings, with demonstrated impact on domain-specific decision-making and measurable improvements in policy performance.

  • Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization methods applied to vision and multimodal learning problems, with a focus on improving policy stability, exploration, and sample efficiency in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities.

  • Strong proficiency in PyTorch and deep learning frameworks for vision and multimodal AI, with hands-on experience building end-to-end RL pipelines covering simulation, training, evaluation, and deployment in production-grade systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to solve core RL challenges in multimodal and vision tasks, such as sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation tradeoffs, and training instability, along with experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on algorithmic improvements to advance agent performance.

  • Proven track record of research publications in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

raw.description:
Anovia (formerly Innovatia Technical Services) is an industry-leading technology outsourcing support provider with expertise in the telecommunications industry. Operating for over 20 years, we specialize in workflow and knowledge processes, as well as technical support, helpdesk and multilingual support services. With over 200 professional experts across the globe, we service some of the worlds’ most successful Fortune 500 and Fortune 1000 companies.

About the Role

Anovia is looking for a Project Engineer to deliver Microsoft 365, identity, and migration projects for our clients. This is hands-on cloud engineering, not advisory work: you build and harden tenants, untangle hybrid identity, manage devices through Intune, and move mail, files, and users between platforms without losing data or a weekend.

You will work across many client tenants at once, typically with two to five projects running in parallel at different stages. Each project is yours to execute — discovery, build, pilot, cutover, handover — with a senior engineer available for architecture calls.

The experience bar

• 5-10 years in IT overall, with at least 2 years administering Microsoft 365 and Entra IDacross more than one organization or tenant.

• At least five migrations you personally executed— mailbox, tenant-to-tenant, file, or Active Directory domain — with the tooling you used named.

• You own the technical execution and escalate architecture decisions. You are not expected to design a client's identity strategy from scratch; you are expected to implement one correctly and spot when it is wrong.

What you'll do

Migrations

• Run mailbox, tenant, file, and domain migrations end to end using various migration tools — discovery, pilot group, cutover plan, cutover, post-cutover support.

• Agree rollback criteria and a downtime window with the client before the window opens, and hold to them.

• Reconcile what actually moved against what was supposed to move, and chase the difference.

Microsoft 365 and Entra ID

• Run mailbox, tenant, file, and domain migrations end to end using various migration tools — discovery, pilot group, cutover plan, cutover, post-cutover support.

• Agree rollback criteria and a downtime window with the client before the window opens and hold to them.

• Reconcile what moved against what was supposed to move and chase the difference.

Azure and endpoints

• Deploy and maintain Azure infrastructure: VMs, virtual networks, NSGs, site-to-site VPN, Azure Files, Azure Backup, and Azure Virtual Desktop where clients use it.

• Manage client devices through Intune: Autopilot enrolment, compliance and configuration profiles, app packaging and deployment, BitLocker and Defender policy, update rings.

Delivery and handover

• Write the as-built documentation into IT Glue and brief the service desk, so nothing undocumented is left behind.

• Keep project time and status current in the PSA so account managers can see where things stand.

• Join client calls to explain what is changing, what will briefly break, and when.

Required qualifications

All four of the pillars below are required. Within each, you should be able to do most of what is listed without supervision.

1. Microsoft 365 administration

• Exchange Online: mail flow, connectors, transport rules, shared and resource mailboxes, mailbox delegation, message trace, retention basics

• Mail DNS: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Autodiscover, and what TTL does to a cutover

• SharePoint Online and OneDrive: site and library creation, permission inheritance, sharing policies, sync troubleshooting

• Microsoft Teams: provisioning, guest access, and how Teams relates to the SharePoint site behind it

• Microsoft 365 admin center, license assignment, and group-based licensing

2. Entra ID (formerly Azure AD)

• Users, groups, dynamic groups, administrative roles and units

• Entra Connect Sync or Cloud Sync: installation, OU and attribute filtering, and resolving sync errors

• Hybrid join versus Entra join, and when each applies

• Conditional Access policy design, MFA rollout, SSPR, and why security defaults are not enough

• Enterprise applications and SAML or OIDC single sign-on

3. Azure

• Virtual machines, virtual networks, NSGs, public IPs, site-to-site VPN

• Azure Files with AD DS or Entra authentication; Azure Virtual Desktop basics

• Azure Backup and Recovery Services vaults

• Subscriptions, resource groups, RBAC, and enough cost management to not surprise a client

4. Intune

• Enrollment: Windows Autopilot, co-management, BYOD, Apple and Android enrollment

• Compliance policies, configuration profiles, and the Settings Catalog

• App deployment: Win32 packaging (.intunewin), Store apps, and line-of-business apps

• BitLocker policy and Defender for Endpoint onboarding

• Update rings and Windows Update for Business

5. Migration delivery— demonstrable experience in at least two of:

• On-premises Exchange to Exchange Online: cutover, staged, or hybrid using the Hybrid Configuration Wizard

• Tenant-to-tenant migration following an acquisition, divestiture, or rebrand

• Google Workspace or IMAP to Microsoft 365

• File server or NAS to SharePoint Online, OneDrive, or Teams

• Active Directory domain migration or consolidation: ADMT, SID history, forest trusts, UPN suffix change, workstation re-domain

• Another MDM platform into Intune

6. Windows Server and AD DS

• Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, file and print services

• Hyper-V setup and configuration

7. PowerShell

• Bulk operations against Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph, and Entra

• You read and modify scripts rather than only running ones you found

8. Working style

• Experience working on a fully remote team.

• Client-facing: comfortable explaining a downtime window to a non-technical stakeholder.

• Documentation discipline — across many tenants, undocumented work is lost work.

• Available for scheduled after-hours and weekend cutover windows.

• Prior MSP or multi-client experience.

Required qualifications

• Security and compliance:Microsoft Purview (DLP, retention, sensitivity labels, eDiscovery), Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, Secure Score remediation, CIS benchmarks, HIPAA or CMMC-adjacent client work

• Privileged identity:Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, entitlement management

• Automation:Power Automate, Power Apps, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Graph API scripting beyond cmdlets

Helpful Qualifications

• Microsoft 365 backup and BCDR:Veeam, Datto, Dropsuite, Afi, Acronis, Keepit

• Hypervisors:VMware ESXi, Nutanix Acropolis

• Other platforms:AWS, Google Workspace administration, Egnyte, Citrix ShareFile, Cloudflare, QuickBooks Online

• Apple ecosystem:macOS and iOS deployment, Apple Business Manager, Jamf, Mosyle, or Intune for Mac

• Network and edge:SonicWall and Fortinet firewalls, Cisco Meraki and Ubiquiti wireless, Cisco and Dell switching

• Storage:QNAP, Synology, and Dell NAS, particularly as a migration source

• MSP tooling:ConnectWise Manage and Automate, Sention, Autotask, Kaseya, NinjaOne, Datto RMM, IT Glue, Hudu; multi-tenant M365 administration tools such as Nerdio, inforcer, CIPP; password management such as Keeper; M365 migration tools such as BitTitan.

Certifications

At least one current Microsoft role-based certification, or demonstrable equivalent experience. Examples:

· MS-102- Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert

· SC-300- Identity and Access Administrator

· MD-102- Endpoint Administrator

· AZ-104- Azure Administrator Associate

· AZ-800 / AZ-801- Windows Server Hybrid Administrator

· MS-700- Teams Administrator

· SC-200- Security Operations Analyst

Benefits at Anovia

  • Comprehensive Health Insurance policy
  • Employee Wellness Program with focus on mental health
  • Robust reward and recognition programs
  • Company incentive programs offered
  • Attractive leave policy: Holiday Leave, Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Birthday leave, Bereavement Leave and Paid Leave for personal time off
  • Ample growth and learning opportunities
  • Remote work opportunities
  • Focus on work/life balance
  • Immigration Program supporting immigration to Canada for eligible employees

We thank all candidates for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
Anovia is an equal opportunity employer.

Salary: ₹2,000,000 – ₹2,300,000 / year

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Responsabilities

Engineering

  • Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

  • Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

  • Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

  • Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

Product Partnership

  • Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

  • Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

  • Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

  • Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

Leadership

  • Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.

  • Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.

  • Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Requirements

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

  • Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source.

raw.excerpt: Peraton OverviewPeraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy.
raw.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Senior IBM MQ Administrator to support a large, complex enterprise banking environment. The ideal candidate will bring strong IT experience, including hands-on IBM MQ (WebSphere MQ) administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and production support.

Successful candidates will have strong Unix/Linux administration skills, particularly with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) or AIX, and experience supporting high-volume, mission-critical messaging environments. Experience within large financial institutions or similarly complex enterprise environments is highly desirable.

Day to Day Work Responsibilities:

  • Administer, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot IBM MQ environments supporting enterprise applications.
  • Manage queue managers, channels, clustering, distributed queuing, and message delivery.
  • Monitor queue depths, channel status, system performance, and message processing to ensure availability and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot complex MQ issues, including failed transactions, dead letter queues, connectivity problems, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Perform IBM MQ installations, upgrades, patching, and configuration changes.
  • Administer and support Unix/Linux environments, particularly RHEL and AIX.
  • Develop and maintain shell scripts to automate administration, monitoring, and operational tasks.
  • Manage SSL/TLS certificates, authentication, authorization, and MQ security configurations.
  • Support incident resolution, root cause analysis, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
  • Collaborate with application development, infrastructure, and operations teams to resolve technical issues.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Participate in production support and on-call activities as required.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and approximately 8 years of professional experience; or an Associate's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and 10 years of professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 12 years of professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on IBM MQ (WebSphere MQ) administration experience.
  • Strong Unix/Linux administration experience, specifically RHEL or AIX.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting IBM MQ in large, complex, high-availability enterprise environments.
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting queue managers, channels, clustering, and distributed messaging.
  • Proficiency in shell scripting (bash or ksh).
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, SSL/TLS certificates, and security protocols.
  • Experience with performance monitoring, log analysis, incident management, and root cause analysis.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting IBM MQ within major financial institutions, banking organizations, or similarly complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience with IBM Integration Bus, Apache Kafka, or other middleware technologies.
  • Familiarity with Windows Server administration and PowerShell scripting.
  • Knowledge of LDAP integration, firewall configurations, and enterprise security practices.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

raw.title: AI Research Engineer (Model Compression & Quantization)
raw.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of our AI research team, you will drive innovation in model compression and efficient deployment for advanced multimodal AI systems, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). Your work will focus on reducing model footprint and computational cost while preserving accuracy, enabling high-performance AI to run efficiently across resource-constrained edge devices. You will apply and advance compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to streamline complex multimodal architectures that integrate text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in model compression methods and a strong background in multimodal model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel compression strategies that balance model size, latency, throughput, and accuracy. Your responsibilities include building robust compression pipelines, establishing performance and fidelity metrics, and addressing bottlenecks in production inference. The ultimate goal is to deliver scalable, low-memory, low-latency AI systems on edge devices (i.e., smartphones) that maintain high fidelity and tangible real-world value.

Responsibilities

Break down the key responsibilities in bullet points. It’s helpful to make them actionable and measurable. This could also be grouped into categories for more complex roles.

  • Apply low-bit quantization to reduce model size and inference latency for generative AI models (LLMs, VLMs, multimodal) while maintaining accuracy and output quality.

  • Leverage knowledge distillation to transfer capabilities from larger teacher models to smaller student models, enabling efficient multimodal reasoning across text, image, and audio inputs.

  • Implement pruning techniques to remove redundant parameters and attention heads, reducing computational overhead without sacrificing task performance.

  • Analyze trade-offs between model efficiency (size, latency, memory) and accuracy across quantization, distillation, and pruning methods; propose improvements based on empirical findings.

  • Research and apply mixed-precision quantization and other advanced compression strategies (e.g., adaptive pruning schedules, distillation with intermediate feature matching) to optimize the accuracy–performance balance.

  • Stay current with the latest research in model compression, including emerging techniques for multimodal and generative architectures.

  • Document methodologies, experiments, and results clearly to support reproducibility, internal collaboration, and stakeholder communication.

  • Author technical papers and publish findings in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) to advance the field of model compression for multimodal AI.

Requirements

List the qualifications, certifications, and experience needed for the role. You can split this into mandatory and preferred sections if needed.

  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Experience with PyTorch deep learning frameworks or equivalent frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with model quantization including both Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) and Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

  • Research and hands-on experience with knowledge distillation for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Research and hands-on experience with model pruning for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Solid understanding of neural network architectures and training processes – Including transformers (e.g., LLMs, VLMs), backpropagation, optimization, and fine-tuning techniques.

  • Familiarity with C++ is a plus (especially for implementing low-level quantization kernels or inference optimizations).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

raw.description:
We willen dat iedereen in Nederland de best mogelijke hypotheek heeft. Ons team bestaat uit meer dan 30 Fritsers die dagelijks Frits beter, slimmer, klantvriendelijker, bekender en leuker maken. Dat doen we samen. We dagen elkaar uit en staan voor elkaar klaar. Zo maken we die ambitie werkelijkheid. Wij zijn Frits.

Wat je van ons kunt verwachten

Wij helpen je graag goed op weg. Daarom zorgen wij ervoor dat de leads die je binnenkrijgt, van hoge kwaliteit zijn. Je helpt klanten om hen zo goed mogelijk inzicht te krijgen in de mogelijkheden. Met de hulp van onze slimme software. Die berekent alles in no-time en denkt meerdere scenario’s voor je uit. Zo kun jij je focussen op de klant.

Flexibiliteit is belangrijk. Je bent vrij om zelf je agenda in te delen en je uren te bepalen. Wil je naast je werk ook eigen klanten adviseren? Ga ervoor. Zelf kiezen waar je werkt? Jij bepaalt. En ga je op vakantie? Dan is er een team Fritsers die je klanten tijdelijk kunnen overnemen.

Waarom je bij ons past

Je houdt ervan om grenzen te verleggen. En ook van nieuwe dingen leren. Je levert graag mooie resultaten en zet alles op alles om klanten goed te helpen. Je werkt makkelijk samen en ziet niet snel dingen over het hoofd. Klinkt bekend? Dan voel je je hier als een vis in ‘t water.

Requirements

  • Je werkt al minimaal vijf jaar als adviseur.

  • Je hebt ervaring met klanten uit verschillende situaties. Denk aan starters, verhuizers, oversluiters of ondernemers.

  • Je hebt up-to-date WFT’s op zak.

Diversiteit & Inclusiviteit

Bij Frits is iedereen welkom. We vinden het superbelangrijk dat de werkomgeving van iedere Fritser veilig voelt en inclusief is. Onafhankelijk van wie je bent of waar je vandaan komt. Diversiteit maakt ons juist sterker, beter en zorgt ervoor dat we een open en heldere blik hebben. Om dit te behouden hebben we een sollicitatieprocedure opgezet waar iedereen gelijke kansen krijgt om aangenomen te worden. Welkom bij de Frits Family.

Extra informatie

Beloningsmodel

Bij Frits werken we met een beloningsmodel dat net even anders is. Zo krijg je bij ons geen uurtarief of stukloon maar word je betaald per fase: zo hebben we een oriëntatie-, advies- en bemiddelingsfase. Aan het einde van de maand berekent Frits hoeveel afgeronde fases je kunt factureren. Daarna hoef jij alleen nog de factuur te sturen: lekker makkelijk.

Het is natuurlijk ook fijn om concreet te weten wat je gaat verdienen. Per finaal akkoord verdien je gemiddeld EUR 640. De meeste zzp’ers die fulltime voor ons werken, sluiten gemiddeld 14-16 hypotheken per maand af. Afhankelijk van hoeveel je werkt, heb je zo een idee van wat je kunt verdienen.

Beschikbaarheid

Je bent vrij om je eigen uren in te delen en te bepalen waar je werkt. Op ons kantoor of liever thuis: wat jij het fijnst vindt. Het is wel belangrijk dat je minimaal 24 uur per week beschikbaar bent.

Fritser aan ‘t woord

Benieuwd naar het verhaal van een toekomstige collega? Marilyn werkt ook als zzp adviseur bij Frits! Je leest haar verhaal hier.

verifies training rosters, LMS completion records, and HR system (HRIS) data to ensure accurate data and maintains tracking of repeated errors until rectified. • Writes and updates step-by-step raw.description:
Senior SDET

Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare? Do you take pride in building and maintaining robust test automation frameworks? Are you passionate about improving deployment processes for high-impact products?

Boxes ticked? If so, read on.

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

We are a passionate and driven team, lucky to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact - We do work that matters.
  • Collaboration – We are in it together.
  • Human touch – We care deeply.

This role can be fully remote in the UK and EU (with occasional travel to our London office) within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

What you will be doing

The Senior SDET, Frameworks role will lead the evolution of Semble’s test automation capability and help make quality a shared engineering discipline. You will:

  • Lead the transformation towards a Quality Agent System, using AI agents and deterministic automation to continuously identify coverage gaps, generate and maintain tests, detect flaky tests, support exploratory testing, and surface reproducible defects.
  • Design safe, maintainable agent workflows with clear responsibilities, isolated execution, human review, and appropriate controls. Agents should assist engineers and SDETs, not replace human judgement or merge their own changes.
  • Establish the foundations required for this system, including a stable Playwright framework, reliable CI integration, ephemeral test environments, test data management, quality observability, and structured test knowledge.
  • Set up meaningful quality gates in CI and PR workflows, including coverage validation, framework conventions, high-risk code checks, and actionable failure reporting.
  • Rationalise our overcrowded E2E suite by identifying tests that belong at unit, API, or integration level, keeping E2E focused on critical user journeys.
  • Build and maintain a cross-layer coverage map and risk-based defect view, helping teams understand where quality gaps exist and where automation investment will have the greatest impact.
  • Expand test coverage and surface quality gaps earlier in the development lifecycle, including through test scenario generation, mutation testing, and AI-assisted exploratory testing.
  • Conduct proof-of-concepts for non-functional testing, including performance, accessibility, security, and reliability testing.
  • Contribute to company-wide quality strategy, tooling decisions, quality metrics, and shift-left adoption alongside the wider SDET and Engineering teams.
  • Coach engineers and SDETs on effective test design, the testing pyramid, Playwright, and contributing to the shared framework.

What we are looking for

At a Senior level at Semble, we will expect you to be mostly autonomous in your scope and to own and solve complex tasks or lead projects independently. You will work with peers from different functions and have an impact across department. You may be in a mentoring role for more junior team members and should be able to influence effectively and lead by example throughout the company.

  • 5+ years of professional experience as SDET or Test Automation Engineer
  • A strong track record of designing, building, and evolving automation frameworks that are reliable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to adopt.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-augmented or agentic quality workflows, not only using tools such as Cursor or Claude to generate test code.
  • A pragmatic approach to AI adoption, with awareness of data privacy, security, clinical safety, cost, and false-positive risks.
  • Strong commercial experience with TypeScript-based automation frameworks. Playwright experience is highly desirable.
  • Experience with test coverage strategy and applying the testing pyramid to reduce unnecessary E2E testing.
  • Experience with write unit, component, API and integration tests.
  • Experience with performance testing tools, such as k6, is desirable.
  • Knowledge of non-functional testing, including performance, accessibility, security, and reliability.
  • Exposure to DevOps tools and cloud infrastructure, including Jenkins, Bitbucket, Datadog, and AWS.

General Description:

  • Accountable for regional study delivery with appropriate inspection readiness quality, within agreed timelines and budget
  • Leads the regional clinical operations team (including oversight of external partners working on the regional level) and acts as point of escalation for resolution of issues within the region for the assigned study
  • Ensures alignment of regional deliverables with overall study goals

Regional Leadership

  • Leads the regional clinical operations team effectively, ensures effective decision making and acts as point of escalation for resolution of issues within the region for the assigned study
  • Leads external vendors involved in study delivery on a regional level
  • Collaborates with key stakeholders in the region and provides regular updates on study progress in the region to senior management and Global Clinical Study Manager as required
  • Represents the regional study team at internal meetings and at the cross-functional Clinical Study Team (CST) meetings
  • Leads regional operations meetings with all regional study team members

Timelines, Planning and Execution

  • Leads planning and management of the assigned clinical study(ies) from feasibility through closeout activities for region, in line with global study timelines
  • Generates, manages, and maintains high quality study start up and recruitment timelines for region and tracks progress towards these
  • Ensures that the clinical study is operationally feasible in the region, drives trial feasibility, country allocation and site selection process for assigned region in collaboration with feasibility managers, country heads, medical affairs and any other stakeholders
  • Provides regional input on global study plans as required
  • Ensures timely availability of local adaptations of global study documents such as informed consent forms, in close collaboration with other key stake holders to ensure timely submission to regulatory authorities and ECs/IRBs
  • Accountable for submissions of study in countries in assigned region in close collaboration with regional study start up team and regulatory affairs
  • Ensures regional and country information in study systems and tools is entered and up to date
  • Collaborates closely with CRAs in the region to ensure proper study execution at the sites. Reviews and signs-off monitoring reports

  • As required, supports planning and execution of the Clinical Study Report in collaboration with Global Clinical Study Manager and Medical Writing

Quality:

  • Handles escalated issues or problems with the sites in region in close collaboration with stakeholders such as country heads
  • Monitors study activities in region to ensure compliance with the study protocol, SOPs, ICH/GCP and all other relevant regulations
  • Ensures inspection readiness for study in region at any point in time throughout the study life cycle
  • Informs Global Clinical Study Manager of any issues arising on the study, evaluates impact and ensures solutions are implemented
  • Prepares sites for quality assurance audits and inspections, drives responses to audit and inspection findings as appropriate
  • Collaborates with CST members and colleagues to ensure cross-team, site learnings, and best practices are shared
  • Leads improvements and partners with CST members to enhance efficiency and the quality of the work performed on assigned studies
  • Contributes to development, optimization and review of work instructions and SOPs as required

Budget and Resources

  • Works with the sourcing team to select and manage regional study vendors
  • Manages regional study budgets
  • Works closely with Clinical Business Operation on investigator fees, site payment issues and patient travel reimbursement activities
  • Identifies and manages regional team resource needs and establishes contingency plans for key resources

Education Required:

Bachelor’s Degree in a scientific or healthcare discipline required*, Higher Degree preferred

Other Qualifications:

  • 4 or more years of progressive experience in clinical research within biotech, pharma or CRO industry
  • Proven experience in clinical research including relevant experience as team lead in clinical functions
  • Experience as CRA is preferred

Computer Skills: Efficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, MS Project, MS PowerPoint and Outlook.

Travel: Travel might be required as per business need

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity, and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

Purpose of the Role

The primary objective of this role is to remove operational and administrative workload from the Managing Partner, allowing greater focus on revenue-generating activities including business development, client acquisition, relationship management, physician assessment, and executive search.

This is a systems-focused position requiring strong organizational skills, ownership, follow-through, and attention to detail.

Recruitment Operations

    • Updated CVs

    • Licenses and registrations
    • Fellowship certificates

CV Branding & Documentation

  • Format physician CVs according to SylvCare Talent branding standards.

  • Prepare candidate profiles and executive summaries.
  • Organize supporting documents and credential files.

Executive Support

  • Manage calendar and scheduling.
  • Coordinate meetings with clients and candidates.
  • Organize travel arrangements and conference logistics.
  • Track follow-up actions and ensure deadlines are met.
  • Maintain organized digital filing systems.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and follow-up notes.

Business Development Support

  • Maintain CRM and client databases.
  • Track outreach activities and follow-up schedules.
  • Research healthcare organizations and decision makers.
  • Assist with LinkedIn content scheduling and posting.
  • Monitor recruitment pipelines and prepare weekly reports.

Process & Systems Development

  • Build and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Develop templates for:
    • Candidate submissions
    • Follow-up emails
    • Interview coordination
    • Credential collection
    • Client updates
  • Identify inefficiencies and recommend process improvements.
  • Ensure consistent documentation and workflow management across all assignments.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in executive assistance, recruitment coordination, healthcare recruitment, or operations support.
  • Exceptional organizational and administrative skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
  • Experience working with ATS, CRM, or recruitment systems is preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Experience

  • Healthcare recruitment.
  • Physician recruitment.
  • GCC healthcare market exposure.
  • LinkedIn Recruiter or sourcing experience.
  • Document formatting and professional CV preparation.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Candidate document completion rate.
  • Interview scheduling turnaround time.
  • ATS data accuracy.
  • CV preparation turnaround time.
  • Follow-up completion rate.
  • Pipeline reporting accuracy.
  • Administrative workload reduction for Managing Partner.

What Success Looks Like

Within 90 days, the Executive Assistant & Recruitment Operations Coordinator should:

  • Manage candidate documentation independently.
  • Maintain organized ATS and recruitment records.
  • Deliver branded CV drafts ready for final review.
  • Ensure all candidate follow-ups occur without reminders.
  • Manage scheduling and coordination activities proactively.

raw.description:
Hello! 🦜

Thanks for checking out our job posting. You’ve already taken a tiny step towards being a part of our team – huzzah! We know that taking your next career step is as exciting as it can be exhausting. So, with that in mind, we’ve tried to keep our description simple and cliché-free to help you decide if PerchPeek and this role are a good match for you.

About PerchPeek

At PerchPeek we dream of a borderless world where people have the freedom to live and work where they please. Where ideas and resources flow where they’re most needed unrestricted by national borders. We strive to create a world of opportunity for anyone, anywhere – one move at a time.

We’re building a streamlined Mobility ecosystem to empower businesses and individuals to move anywhere in the world. We support employers and employees through every stage of the relocation process, providing an affordable, scalable, high-value service, powered by technology and relocation expertise.

Have you ever relocated? If so, you probably know how overwhelming it can be—immigration hoops, tax implications, housing, shipping, utilities, banking…the list goes on. No matter where in the world you go, relocating is complicated, time-intensive, and stressful. PerchPeek was conceived to change that.

For relocators employees, our goal is to guide them through every step of their move with a delightful mix of tech, coaching, content, and partnerships which work together to make relocating simpler, faster, and more fun.

For employers, we streamline the entire process of supporting international Mobility into one easy-to-use platform, turning Mobility into a strategic advantage for thriving globally.

Now you know why we’re so passionate about what we do!

About the role

The Senior Account Executive will win new business across the UK and Europe, focusing on fast-growing tech and AI scale-ups alongside larger enterprise mobility deals. You’ll build most of your own pipeline and own the full sales cycle, with a target of 1–2 new pilots per month once ramped, converting successful pilots into full rollouts. A successful candidate is a consistently high-performing, autonomous seller with a track record of generating pipeline and closing complex deals, who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to help shape the future of go-to-market at PerchPeek!

Role Responsibilities

Whilst every role in a startup has a degree of flexibility over time, here is what we see as the role’s main responsibilities:

  • Land new logos through pilots - Take fast-growing European scale-ups & enterprises from first conversation to a signed pilot, then convert that pilot into a full rollout.
  • Target clients - Fast-growing tech and AI scale-ups in the UK and Europe (roughly 500 to 5,000 employees). We already work with many of Europe’s fastest growing organisations and are targeting the rest. Once ramped, expect to land 1 to 2 new pilots per month.
  • Enterprise Mobility deals – About a quarter of the role is larger, mobility-led enterprise deals that come from industry events, often through RFPs and longer sales processes.
  • Build your own pipeline - You'll generate most of your pipeline through network, referrals, founders and VCs, trigger-based outbound and events.
  • Playbook input - We're still relatively early in our GTM journey and we'll be counting on you to shape how we win here and pave the way for future AEs.
  • Build the PerchPeek Network – Develop and grow relationships with others in the Mobility industry; be a PerchPeek evangelist and represent PerchPeek at events (online/offline, owned and externally organized).

About You

The type of person we think will be awesome in this role will likely have a track record of the below skills and experience:

  • A track record of being a consistently top performing AE - ranked in top 1 or 2 of their team
  • Experience running a pilot or proof-of-concept and converting it into a full contract
  • Built their own pipeline: a large share of past closed revenue was self-sourced
  • Experience running full sales cycles with multiple stakeholders
  • Comfortable with fast change and light structure; we value autonomous learning and think the best fit for this role is someone who doesn't need daily coaching
  • Willing (and able!) to Travel throughout Europe – we are a fully remote company, which means you’ll predominantly be able to work wherever you’d like. However, you should expect to travel throughout the year for this role, whether that’s for client meetings, conferences, networking functions or staff events.

While not necessary, we’re especially interested in candidates with the below:

  • Experience selling into HR or People teams at scale-ups
  • Experience selling a usage-based or consumption product
  • Experience with consultative selling / managed services
  • Experience running RFP-led enterprise deals through procurement

Crum & Forster Company Overview

Crum & Forster (C&F), with a proud history dating to 1822, provides specialty and standard commercial lines insurance products through our admitted and surplus lines insurance companies. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best and is proud of our superior customer service platform. Our claims and risk engineering services are recognized as among the best in the industry.

Our most valuable asset is our people: more than 2000 employees in locations throughout the United States. The company is increasingly winning recognition as a great place to work, earning several workplace and wellness awards, including the 2025 Great Place to Work® Award for our employee-first focus and our steadfast commitment to diversity, equity and Inclusion.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings, a global, billion dollar organization. For more information about Crum & Forster, please visit our website: www.cfins.com.

C&F’s Commercial Lines division delivers specialized insurance solutions for mid-sized and large businesses across a broad range of commercial exposures, management liabilities, and industry segments. Our portfolio includes tailored coverage solutions for General Liability, Commercial Auto, Workers’ Compensation, Property, and Excess Liability, as well as Financial Lines products such as Management Liability, Professional Liability, Cyber, Crime, and Fidelity.

With more than 700 employees across the United States, Commercial Lines combines deep underwriting expertise, disciplined risk selection, and the strength of C&F’s national platform. We work closely with our customers and distribution partners to provide responsive service, thoughtful risk solutions, and the confidence to navigate complex business challenges.

Job Description

The Commercial Lines Division is seeking an actuary with strong pricing expertise, particularly in large-account, loss-sensitive Commercial Lines business. This role reports to the AVP leading Risk Management and Construction and offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in an entrepreneurial environment.

At C&F, you’ll have the best of both worlds: the agility and collaboration of a nimble organization, combined with the strength, stability, and long-term opportunity of Fairfax’s global presence.

This position will focus primarily on partnering closely with underwriters to evaluate and price complex new and renewal business, applying sound actuarial judgement to support timely and informed pricing decisions. The role will also contribute to enhancing our loss rating tools and leveraging emerging technology and AI-driven capabilities to advance pricing sophistication, analytics & efficiency. The primary lines of business focus include Workers Compensation, Commercial Auto, General Liability, and Umbrella.

You will also be part of the broader Commercial and Financial Lines actuarial pricing team, a collaborative group of approximately 10 actuaries, providing strong opportunities for partnership, mentorship, and knowledge sharing.

What You Will Do

  • Partner closely with underwriters to independently evaluate and price complex, large-account casualty risks, applying sound actuarial judgement to develop pricing recommendations
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance loss rating models and analytical tools
  • Maintain monitoring of overall book pricing levels for accounts not referred to actuarial
  • Help drive innovation by incorporating new technologies, data capabilities, and AI-enabled approaches into pricing tools and processes
  • Collaborate effectively with the broader actuarial team to support shared objectives and continuous improvement

What You Will Bring to C&F

  • ACAS or FCAS designation
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and 8+ years of Commercial P&C actuarial pricing experience
  • Experience pricing large-account, loss-sensitive casualty programs, preferably including large deductible business across Workers Compensation, General Liability and Commercial Auto
  • Strong actuarial judgment with the ability to evaluate competing methodologies, navigate uncertainty and develop practical, well-supported recommendations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and adaptability
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a fast paced, business-facing environment
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to nontechnical audiences
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and consistently meet deadlines
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products and SQL
  • Commitment to compliance with all C&F policies and procedures

What C&F will bring to you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness, including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • A core C&F tenet is owning your career development, so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry-related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment
  • We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee-driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community

At C&F you will BELONG

If you require special accommodations, please let us know. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you require special accommodations, please let us know. Belonging at C&F, is a mindset. It’s about fostering a culture of inclusion and connection, where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive and where our social impact efforts help strengthen the communities where we live and work.

For California Residents Only: Information collected and processed as part of your career profile and any job applications you choose to submit are subject to our privacy notices and policies, visit for more information.

Crum & Forster is committed to ensuring a workplace free from discriminatory pay disparities and complying with applicable pay equity laws. Salary ranges are available for all positions at this location, taking into account roles with a comparable level of responsibility and impact in the relevant labor market and these salary ranges are regularly reviewed and adjusted in accordance with prevailing market conditions. The annualized base pay for the advertised position, located in the specified area, ranges from a minimum of $95,600.00 to a maximum of $179,600.00. The actual compensation is determined by various factors, including but not limited to the market pay for the jobs at each level, the responsibilities and skills required for each job, and the employee’s contribution (performance) in that role. To be considered within market range, a salary is at or above the minimum of the range. You may also have the opportunity to participate in discretionary equity (stock) based compensation and/or performance-based variable pay programs.

raw.description:
DEPARTMENT:Regulatory Affairs

LOCATION: Headquarters or Remote, East Coast US

COMPANY:Humacyte Inc (Nasdaq: HUMA) is developing a disruptive biotechnology platform to deliver universally implantable bioengineered human tissues, advanced tissue constructs, and organ systems designed to improve the lives of patients and transform the practice of medicine. The Company develops and manufactures acellular tissues to treat a wide range of diseases, injuries, and chronic conditions. Humacyte’s initial opportunity, a portfolio of Acellular Tissue Engineered Vessel (ATEVs), is currently approved for use in vascular trauma repair and is in late-stage clinical trials targeting multiple other applications including AV access for hemodialysis and peripheral arterial disease. Preclinical development is also underway in coronary artery bypass grafts, pediatric heart surgery, treatment of type 1 diabetes, and multiple novel cell and tissue applications. Humacyte’s 6mm ATEV for AV access in hemodialysis was the first product candidate to receive the FDA’s Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation and has also received FDA Fast Track designation. Humacyte’s 6mm ATEV for urgent arterial repair following extremity vascular trauma also received the RMAT designation. For more information, visit www.Humacyte.com.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director of Regulatory Affairs is a key member of the Regulatory Affairs team, reporting to the Chief Regulatory Officer. This position serves as Humacyte’s liaison to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for assigned projects in clinical development.

The Director functions as Regulatory Lead and partners with multidisciplinary, matrixed project teams to meet project deliverables while adhering to regulatory requirements for development programs and products. This role develops and executes regulatory strategies for products in early- and late-stage development and leads or co-leads assigned regulatory projects and submission activities.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Serve as the FDA point of contact for assigned development programs and coordinate regulatory communications.
  • Co-lead cross-functional Biologics License Application (BLA) submission efforts, coordinating contributions and timelines across functions.
  • Serve as regulatory strategist and regulatory project lead or co-lead for assigned projects.
  • Develop and implement U.S. and global regulatory strategies for assigned projects.
  • Serve as subject matter expert for clinical modules in regulatory filings.
  • Monitor and interpret new policies and guidance from FDA and other health authorities and assess their impact on assigned programs and company business.
  • As assigned, serve as global regulatory lead, coordinating document preparation and interactions with other health authorities.
  • Coach and mentor junior staff supporting the Regulatory Affairs team, as needed.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Graduate degree in a life science; such as Ph.D., M.D., or Pharm.D. highly preferred.
  • At least five years of regulatory project lead experience required.
  • Recent hands-on experience leading BLA submissions, preferably to FDA’s Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research (CBER).
  • Recent experience supporting biologics development.
  • Demonstrated experience with successful submission and FDA approval of a BLA or New Drug Application (NDA).
  • Experience serving as the point of contact for FDA and other health authorities and leading formal health authority meetings.
  • Knowledge of FDA content and technical requirements for BLA submissions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing regulatory strategies for U.S. Investigational New Drug applications (INDs), BLAs, and/or NDAs.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage submission timelines, and deliver under tight deadlines and high-pressure conditions.
  • Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Effective written and verbal communication in English, strong interpersonal skills, and demonstrated cross-functional leadership.
  • Possess a positive roll-up-the-sleeves attitude and optimistic outlook.
  • Strong ability to work in a fast-paced team environment with fluctuating priorities and demonstrated ability to collaborate within cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to set priorities in a timely manner.
  • High degree of flexibility and adaptability.
  • Self-motivated and organized critical thinker with solid interpersonal and business communication skills.
  • Adhere to company and facility policies and procedures, including SOPs, training, and meeting requirements; maintain required training and certifications.
  • Observe safety precautions and regulations and report safety hazards and potentially unsafe working conditions.
  • Report to work on time and as scheduled, with availability to meet tight deadlines and peak-period demands.
  • Represents the organization in a positive and highly professional manner.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS HIGHLIGHTS:

  • Stock Options
  • 401k Plan with 4% Match and no Vesting Schedule
  • Medical, Vision and Dental Plans
  • Company Paid Long Term/Short Term Disability
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • 23 Days Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 10 Company Designated Holidays + 2 Floating Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave Policies

** Please note, Humacyte does not provide U.S. employment sponsorship and does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party firms and/or agency recruiters. **

About Us

Today, we work with owners and contractors nationwide, delivering complex construction solutions across various industries, including aviation, mission critical, entertainment, and healthcare. Joining IME is more than just finding a job—it's about building a career with opportunities to advance and make an organizational impact. Power your future with IME and be a part of a team that drives success in every project.

About this Role

Intermountain Electric, Inc. (IME) is celebrating 80 years of powering progress across Colorado. Our office teams help deliver safe, smart, and reliable electrical solutions through our people and partnerships, the IME Way.

Through strategic planning, collaboration, and technical excellence, and guided by our values of Integrity, Safety, Ingenuity, Relationships, Craftsmanship, and Spark, we empower our professionals to innovate, support our field teams, and strengthen the partnerships that move our work forward.

Join a team where your expertise fuels the systems that keep communities running!

The VDC Engineer supports electrical construction projects by bridging the gap between BIM VDC Detailers and Leads to ensure coordinated, high-quality models and consistent project standards. This role facilitates communication across teams, supports model management and clash detection, and serves as a key liaison between office and field operations.

BIM Implementation & Standards

Modeling & Coordination

  • Produce 2D drawings, shop drawings, and model-based documentation.
  • Provide model extracts and coordination reports to project teams.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Serve as a liaison between Detailer I/II roles and the BIM VDC Lead.
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers, contractors, and field teams to ensure accurate system integration.

Training & Team Support

Additional duties as assigned.

raw.description:
Position Summary
The Financial & Billing Analyst supports DataSpring’s monthly customer billing cycle end to end, transforming raw usage and transactional data into invoice-ready outputs. The role sits in Finance and works daily with Billing Operations, Accounting, and the department heads. Beyond executing the billing calendar, the analyst builds and maintains the SQL/Python queries, Databricks workflows, validation controls, and Power BI dashboards that keep billing accurate, auditable, and repeatable, and contributes to month-end journal entries, recurring revenue reporting, the annual audit, and the budget and forecast process. It is a hands-on role for a detail-oriented analyst with strong SQL and advanced Excel skills, and a working knowledge of billing and revenue recognition.

The Financial & Billing Analyst is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the Director, Financial Planning & Analysis

Specific Responsibilities

Billing Operations & Data Analytics:

  • Assist in executing the monthly billing cycle across all products and solutions, ensuring timely processing, validation, and delivery of customer invoices and supporting reports.
  • Support the preparation and distribution of customer invoices and supporting detail through the ERP and customer portals; confirm receipt and resolve delivery issues.
  • Serve as a point of contact for customer invoice inquiries; research questions, prepare credit/rebill adjustments, and coordinate with Accounting on collections follow-up.
  • Assist with all billing-related requests and operational tasks to maintain the accuracy and integrity of pricing tables, billing configurations, and customer account data.
  • Support billing quality assurance activities, including audit reviews, data validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate billing outcomes.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to investigate billing discrepancies, implement corrections, and maintain accurate financial and operational records.
  • Maintain billing process documentation, controls, and the billing calendar.
  • Use database queries and analytical tools to perform ad hoc analysis, investigate and resolve billing discrepancies, support customer invoice disputes and audit requests, analyze revenue and product usage, and produce operational and financial reports.
  • Write and maintain SQL/Python queries, views, and Databricks notebooks to analyze product usage, transactions, customer data, and monthly billing volumes by product and customer.
  • Build and schedule Databricks SQL/Python workflows that transform raw usage and transactional data into invoice-ready billing outputs aligned with the monthly billing calendar.
  • Develop automated data-quality and billing validation controls, including duplicate detection, missing-account checks, period-over-period variance analysis, contract and pricing validation, and exception reporting.
  • Maintain billing reference and mapping data, including pricing tiers, product codes, customer hierarchies, contract effective dates, and other inputs used in billing calculations.
  • Develop and maintain billing dashboards and operational reporting in Databricks and Power BI to support billing execution, reconciliation, forecasting, and revenue analysis.
  • Document SQL logic, billing calculations, data definitions, dependencies, controls, and operational runbooks to ensure processes are repeatable, supportable, and audit-ready.
  • Identify and implement data, automation, reporting, and process improvements across billing, budgeting, reconciliation, and financial close activities.

Month-End Close & Reporting:

  • Reconcile billed revenue to the ERP (Dynamics GP) and to Salesforce contract data each month; investigate and clear variances before close.
  • Prepare revenue, deferred revenue, and accrual journal entries and supporting schedules for Accounting review.
  • Prepare recurring month-end reports in accordance with the close calendar.
  • Support the annual financial audit with billing and revenue schedules and sample documentation.
  • Support the annual budget and forecast process.

Skills

  • SQL & Data Analytics: Proficiency with SQL, including joins, CTEs, aggregations, and window functions; experience analyzing and validating large datasets.
  • Data Platforms & Reporting: Experience with Databricks or comparable cloud data platforms and reporting tools such as Power BI.
  • Advanced Excel: Proficiency with pivot tables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, SUMIFS, Power Query, and data reconciliation.
  • Billing & Accounting: Working knowledge of billing processes, revenue recognition, accruals, deferred/unbilled revenue, and month-end close.
  • Data Quality & Controls: Strong analytical and QA mindset with experience identifying discrepancies and building validation controls.
  • Documentation & Process Improvement: Ability to document processes, data definitions, and controls while identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency.
  • Professional Skills: Strong attention to detail, problem-solving, communication, collaboration, organization, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
  • Ability to handle sensitive customer and financial information with discretion.

Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in billing operations, financial analysis, accounting, or a related function.
  • Experience supporting monthly billing and invoicing cycles, reconciliations, and customer invoice inquiries.
  • Experience using SQL, advanced Excel, and data platforms to independently analyze and validate billing data.
  • Experience with financial and business systems; Microsoft Dynamics GP/Business Central, Salesforce, and Adaptive Insights preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail with demonstrated ability to meet recurring billing and month-end close deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain billing and financial variances to non-finance stakeholders.
  • Ability to appropriately handle confidential customer and financial information.
  • Healthcare or health IT experience, including familiarity with health plans, providers, or payer-provider data, preferred.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DataSpring is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued, respected, and empowered.

Employment decisions at DataSpring are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin or ancestry, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, familial status, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, source of income or any other characteristic protected by law. DataSpring does not tolerate unlawful discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Applicants have rights under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA),Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), and the Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA). If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a posted position, please contact the DataSpring People & Culture team at or 202-517-0436.
