Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

Job title:Relationship Manager, Banking & Treasury Services

About Priority:

Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority, we're driven by results. We expect our people tobe known for results- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

About the Role:

As a Relationship Manager, Banking & Treasury Services, you will play a critical role in the long-term success of high-value clients and the company. By ensuring clients achieve their desired outcomes, the role will help drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention, which in turn can lead to increased revenue and business growth. You will act as trusted advisors to clients, helping them to realize the full potential of the company’s offerings and contributing to the overall success and reputation of the company. You will be supporting our core clients who are growing and looking for opportunities to cross-sell our products.

Responsibilities:

Relationship Management:

  • Key point of contact post-integration: Establish and nurture trust-based relationships with clients after integration.

  • Product knowledge and support: Maintain a deep understanding of our banking and treasury management product to effectively address client queries and offer solutions.

  • Regular client check-ins: Conduct periodic meetings to understand clients’ evolving needs and align services to meet those needs.

  • Build an understanding of customer needs to advocate for roadmap and product solutions.

  • Escalation management and collaboration with internal teams to resolve any customer issues.

  • Leading Quarterly Business Reviews with Partners.

  • Continually push for new feature adoption with existing clients.

  • Actively drive increase to bottom line revenue.

  • Assigned to higher-touch enterprise clients.

  • Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures).

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Internal coordination: Collaborate with various internal teams to effectively meet client needs and identify upselling or cross-selling opportunities.

  • Feedback loop: Work with sales, marketing, product, and other departments to provide client feedback, contributing to product improvements and the development of new offerings.

What Success Looks Like:

Success in the Relationship Manager, Banking & Treasury Services role looks like being a trusted advisor to high-value clients while driving measurable business impact. Specifically, success includes:

1. Strong Client Relationships

  • Clients trust you as their main point of contact.

  • They feel supported and confident using the banking/treasury product.

2. Happy & Retained Clients

  • Clients’ issues are resolved quickly.

  • They stay with the company and continue using the product.

3. Product Adoption & Growth

  • Clients understand and use more features of the product.

  • You identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.

4. Being the Voice of the Customer

  • You share client feedback with internal teams.

  • Your insights help improve the product and customer experience.

5. Proactive client management

  • Regular check-ins.

  • Quarterly reviews uncover client needs before problems arise.

6. Effective problem resolution

  • You coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues quickly and escalate when needed.

7. Valuable customer insights

  • Client feedback is consistently shared with product and other teams to improve the platform.

8. Operational excellence

  • Processes, documentation (SOPs), and internal collaboration run smoothly.

In short: Success means keeping clients happy, growing their usage of the product, solving their problems efficiently, and acting as the voice of the customer internally.

Candidate Requirements:

Minimum Requirements:

  • Associate’s degree in Finance, Business, or equivalent work experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in client success, account management, or a relationship management role, preferably in a FinTech or Banking environment.

  • Banking Operations / Treasury Experience preferred.

  • Excellent verbal, written communication and interpersonal skills needed to develop collaborative working relationships with cross functional teams.

  • Ability to understand end to end processes.

  • Patient, diplomatic, and collaborative.

  • Advanced communication skills and the ability to have crucial conversations with our clients.

Work Environment & Culture:

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand -an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

Compensation and Benefits:

Compensation range:$76k - $85k

We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

Financial Wellness

  • Bonus programs

  • 401(k) match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • HSA and FSA options

  • Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs

Health & Well-being

  • Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health

  • Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga)

Time Off

Growth & Development

  • Education expense reimbursement

  • Leadership development programs

  • Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support

We believe great performance starts with feeling supported - and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind.

Traditional Physical Requirements:

  • Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching.

  • Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds.

  • Requires eye-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction).

Category: Retail & Wholesale

Location: Ahmedabad Gujarat IN


VIDEO REQUIRED: Every application must include a 2 minute video. No video, no application. We review your video before your resume. Upload your video here: (details at the bottom).

Earn a base salary plus commission that can double your monthly pay, selling in your own language for a US company.

Midsouth Hotel Supply is a US wholesale supplier of linens, amenities, and furnishings to hotels and motels across the Southeast and Mid South. Most of our customers and prospects are Gujarati speaking hotel owners, so we need someone who can build real trust on the phone in Gujarati and English. We are a small, motivated, tech forward team on cloud software, and this role is 100% remote. You work directly for a US company with US leadership one message away, and your role grows as we grow.

Why this role is worth your attention

  • Starting base pay of 50,000 INR per month
  • Commission on every account you convert, paid when the order is paid. Strong performers can double their monthly pay with commission
  • Commission starts after a 90 day probation, and probation ends as soon as you convert 5 new accounts in a month
  • Paid vacation and sick leave
  • Real US sales experience, with full training and SOPs for everything you do
  • You work day to day with our Business Development Lead, who coaches you and shares what works
  • A role that molds around your strengths. Learn fast and you can grow into marketing, customer onboarding, and more
  • A small, young team with no corporate layers, aiming for world class results

What you will do

  • Call hospitality businesses in English and Gujarati, 50 to 100 calls a day
  • Use our SOPs, AI, and other tools to build your own lead lists, then import them into Zoho CRM and work them yourself
  • Book sample boxes, follow up, and turn leads into customers
  • Log everything in Zoho CRM, using Zoho Mail and RingCentral

What success looks like

  • Convert 5 new accounts a month to finish probation
  • Grow to 15 to 25 new accounts a month
  • You are judged on results you own: calls and follow ups, sample boxes booked, and conversion rate. Not on hours at a desk

Your schedule

Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm US Central, which is a night shift in India. Please apply only if you are comfortable with that long term.

You will love this job if you

  • Have real outbound calling or inside sales experience
  • Speak very strong English with a clear, neutral accent
  • Speak fluent Gujarati and are comfortable selling in it (strongly preferred, since most of our customers speak it)
  • Are self motivated and want your results to speak for you
  • Learn new tools quickly and don't mind wearing more than one hat
  • Have hospitality or wholesale experience (a plus)

This is not for you if

  • You want a relaxed job with no targets
  • You aren't comfortable working a night shift
  • You want a fixed job description that never changes
  • You need someone to hand you a lead list every day

What you need

A reliable computer and internet, a quiet space, a headset, and a webcam. All meetings are remote and on camera.

HOW TO APPLY: THE VIDEO IS REQUIRED

Your video matters more than your resume. We will not review any application without it.

  1. Record a video of 2 minutes or less answering one question: Why would you be the best fit for this role?
  2. Upload your video here:
  3. Then submit your application with your resume.

Tips to stand out: look at the camera and speak naturally, like you are on a call with a customer. Tell us your calling or sales experience and one result you are proud of. Say a few sentences in Gujarati so we can hear you. No editing needed. A phone video in good light and quiet is perfect.

No video means no application. We watch every one.

▪ Knowledge of networking concepts and protocols.

▪ Knowledge of observability and monitoring practices (e.g., logging, tracing, metrics) to ensure system reliability and resilience.

▪ Knowledge of architecture governance and documentation practices (e.g., decision records, C4 diagrams, architecture reviews).

▪ Proven experience with AXON server, KAFKA, Elastic Search

▪ Proven experience with an API Gateway - WSO2 API, Amazon API Gateway, Azure API Gateway, Google Cloud Apigee.

▪ In depth knowledge of CSDR

SKILLS

▪ Capacity to collaborate across teams and communicate architectural concepts.

▪ Skill in simplifying technical architectures into business-relevant language.

▪ Competence in anticipating future needs and designing scalable solutions.

▪ Talent for working across teams to ensure integrated outcomes.

▪ Ability to engage stakeholders to gather requirements and secure buy-in.

▪ Capacity to adjust architectures to reflect emerging technologies.

raw.description:
Overview

The Enterprise Solution Architect (ESA) is the senior technical leader responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the enterprise architecture for a large-scale healthcare supply chain and logistics portfolio.

The ESA leads the sustainment and modernization of legacy business applications, inventory systems, procurement systems, financial management integrations, enterprise data capabilities, and shared digital services. This role establishes the architecture for a centralized integration platform that enables secure, scalable, governed, and near-real-time information exchange across supply chain, logistics, clinical, financial, asset-management, and external partner systems.

The ESA serves as the core technical leader responsible for planning, designing, and governing next-generation autonomous, goal-driven AI systems that support supply-chain modernization, operational decision-making, workflow optimization, enterprise data exchange, and intelligent automation.

This position balances continuity of mission-critical operations with deliberate, phased modernization. The ESA ensures that architecture decisions improve interoperability, data quality, cybersecurity, resiliency, maintainability, delivery velocity, and readiness for future digital capabilities.

This is a critical technical leadership role responsible for enabling a secure, integrated, resilient, and modern healthcare supply-chain ecosystem. The Enterprise Solution Architect protects current operational capabilities while establishing the architecture, governance, integration foundation, data discipline, modernization pathway, and intelligent automation capabilities required for future enterprise transformation.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture Leadership:

  • Establish, maintain, and govern the target-state enterprise architecture for the healthcare supply chain and logistics portfolio.
  • Develop and maintain current-state, future-state, and transition architecture models spanning business, application, data, integration, security, infrastructure, cloud, and operational-support domains.
  • Define enterprise architecture principles, standards, technical guardrails, reference architectures, reusable patterns, and Architecture Decision Records.
  • Lead architecture governance forums, solution-design reviews, technical intake processes, architecture review boards, and executive-level architecture briefings.
  • Ensure architectural decisions align with organizational strategy, technology roadmaps, cybersecurity requirements, business priorities, delivery plans, and operational outcomes.
  • Maintain the enterprise architectural runway, ensuring that near-term product and platform investments advance longer-term modernization objectives.
  • Translate strategic priorities into architecture roadmaps, technical enablers, epics, features, stories, non-functional requirements, and measurable implementation outcomes.
  • Develop architecture artifacts using formal frameworks and methods, including DoDAF, UAF, TOGAF, and comparable enterprise architecture approaches.

Centralized Integration Platform and Near-Real-Time Data Exchange

  • Architect a secure, scalable, governed centralized integration platform supporting near-real-time, API, event-driven, messaging, batch, and legacy exchanges.
  • Establish reusable integration patterns, APIs, data contracts, interface standards, observability, security, and service-level objectives.
  • Enable reliable interoperability among supply chain, inventory, procurement, logistics, financial, clinical, asset-management, and external systems while reducing point-to-point integrations.

Legacy Application Sustainment, Modernization, and Intelligent Automation

  • Lead phased modernization of legacy applications, interfaces, data pipelines, and infrastructure while maintaining continuity of mission-critical operations.
  • Define modernization strategies including API enablement, refactoring, re-platforming, cloud migration, service decomposition, consolidation, replacement, and retirement.
  • Architect and govern AI-enabled capabilities, including agentic workflows, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and human-in-the-loop decision support, with appropriate security, governance, traceability, and human oversight.

Enterprise Data Architecture and Governance

  • Define enterprise data and master-data architecture supporting authoritative, trusted, interoperable, and reusable supply-chain information.
  • Establish data governance, ownership, quality, metadata, lineage, lifecycle, access, authoritative-source, and master-data standards.
  • Enable consistent and secure information sharing across enterprise and external data sources.

Cloud, DevSecOps, Security and Resilliency

  • Define secure hybrid and cloud-native architecture patterns supporting scalability, resiliency, disaster recovery, observability, and cost optimization.
  • Establish automated DevSecOps practices for CI/CD, testing, security scanning, infrastructure automation, configuration management, monitoring, and continuous compliance.
  • Apply Zero Trust, identity and access management, encryption, secrets/certificate management, API security, vulnerability management, and applicable cybersecurity and privacy requirements

Agile Delivery and Cross-Product Coordination

  • Partner with product, engineering, security, data, operations, and business teams to translate architecture into prioritized epics, enablers, features, non-functional requirements, and release plans.
  • Manage cross-product dependencies and balance feature delivery with modernization, cybersecurity, technical-debt reduction, resiliency, and operational sustainment.
  • Define architecture performance measures covering interoperability, data quality, reliability, delivery, technical debt, and modernization progress

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, application architecture, integration architecture, data architecture, cloud architecture, or comparable technical leadership roles.

Domain Experience:

  • Demonstrated experience supporting large-scale healthcare, supply-chain, logistics, procurement, inventory, financial management, clinical, or other mission-critical operational environments.

Architecture Expertise:

  • Experience developing enterprise and solution architectures, reference architectures, current- and future-state models, transition architectures, technical roadmaps, architecture decision records, integration blueprints, and modernization strategies. Ability to apply formal architecture frameworks and modeling approaches, including DoDAF, UAF, TOGAF, and/or equivalent methods.

Integration Expertise:

  • Demonstrated expertise designing API-led, event-driven, message-based, and batch integrations. Must be able to define reusable enterprise integration patterns; API and data contracts; canonical models; service orchestration; interface-versioning strategies; error handling; auditability; and operational monitoring. Experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, Enterprise Service Bus and Enterprise Application Integration patterns, ETL/ELT, publish-subscribe, XML, EDI, HL7, and FHIR is required.

Data Architecture:

  • Experience with enterprise data modeling, master data management, data governance, data quality, metadata management, data lineage, authoritative-source management, data lakes, lakehouses, data migration, and modern data-engineering practices. Experience defining enterprise master-data models for items, vendors, contracts, classification references, and related supply-chain domains is strongly preferred.

Technical Platforms and Technologies

  • Demonstrated architecture-level experience with containerized, cloud-native platforms, including Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift; cloud platforms and services in AWS and Azure; and hybrid IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS environments. Experience with Red Hat technologies, InterSystems integration technologies, Databricks, API-management and integration platforms, enterprise messaging, and data-platform services is required or strongly preferred.

Application and Legacy Technology Expertise:

  • Experience modernizing and sustaining legacy enterprise applications, including applications with complex custom-code, database, file-based, or mainframe-era dependencies. Familiarity with Java, Spring Boot, .NET, Python, React, Angular, Node.js, and MUMPS-based applications is preferred. Candidates should understand API enablement, service decomposition, code refactoring, re-platforming, re-hosting, data migration, and phased legacy-system retirement.

Artificial Intelligence and Automation:

  • Experience designing, governing, or integrating AI-enabled systems, including machine learning, predictive analytics, generative AI, intelligent automation, agentic workflows, natural-language interfaces, workflow orchestration, and human-in-the-loop decision support. Must understand model governance, prompt governance, agent permissions, tool controls, data protection, testing, evaluation, traceability, monitoring, exception management, and responsible AI principles.

DevSecOps and Delivery Automation:

  • Experience establishing and governing DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, source-control workflows, automated testing, code-quality controls, deployment automation, configuration management, release engineering, and rollback strategies. Experience with GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, SonarQube, and comparable CI/CD and quality-management tools is required or strongly preferred.

Cloud Engineering and Observability:

  • Experience designing or governing cloud environments that include virtual private cloud networking, subnets, firewalls, load balancers, security groups, identity and access management roles, container orchestration, monitoring, and resiliency controls. Familiarity with CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, and other application-performance-monitoring tools is preferred.

Security and Compliance:

  • Experience incorporating Zero Trust, identity federation, access control, encryption in transit and at rest, audit logging, boundary protection, secrets management, certificate lifecycle management, vulnerability management, secure coding, and API security into enterprise solution designs. Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, Risk Management Framework, assessment and authorization processes, and federal cybersecurity requirements is strongly preferred.

Identity, Secrets, and Certificate Management:

  • Experience designing or governing identity and access-management integrations, identity federation, service-account management, credential rotation, secrets management, and certificate lifecycle automation. Familiarity with Entra ID, external secrets-management services, PIV/CAC-oriented access controls, and certificate-management platforms is preferred.

Modernization Expertise:

  • Proven ability to modernize legacy applications, interfaces, and data pipelines while maintaining continuity of operations, data integrity, cybersecurity compliance, service availability, and user productivity. Must be able to evaluate and recommend refactoring, re-platforming, re-hosting, re-architecting, encapsulation, cloud migration, data migration, consolidation, replacement, or retirement approaches.

Agile Delivery:

  • Demonstrated success working in a scaled Agile environment and translating architecture into prioritized enablers, epics, features, stories, and release plans. Experience with SAFe, Agile product management, backlog refinement, dependency management, planning increments, architecture synchronization, and technical governance is strongly preferred.

Communication:

  • Exceptional ability to communicate complex architectural concepts, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to executive leaders, business stakeholders, product teams, engineers, cybersecurity personnel, operations teams, and external partners. Ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, technical standards, roadmaps, decision records, and executive-level briefings is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Relevant professional certifications, such as:
    • TOGAF
    • SAFe Architect
    • SAFe Agile Product Manager
    • AWS Certified Solutions Architect
    • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect
    • Red Hat Certified Specialist or Architect in OpenShift or cloud-native applications
    • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
    • Databricks Certified Data Engineer
    • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
    • Equivalent architecture, cloud, security, data, or Agile certifications
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability standards, including HL7 and FHIR.
  • Experience integrating inventory, procurement, financial management, enterprise resource planning, clinical, logistics, warehouse-management, or asset-management systems.
  • Experience with API management, enterprise integration, service orchestration, or middleware platforms.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms, data lakes, lakehouses, data engineering, master data management, and modern ETL/ELT tooling.
  • Experience designing or governing enterprise item, vendor, contract, classification, reference-data, or master-data-management solutions.
  • Experience integrating external government, regulatory, manufacturer, supplier, vendor-validation, or product-identification data sources.
  • Experience in a federal, public-sector, healthcare, or other highly regulated environment.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, health informatics, data management, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain a Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust and a VA PIV credential.

Location:

  • Remote, USA.

Pay Range:

  • The suggested pay for this position ranges from $210,000 to $250,000.
  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
  • Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.
  • TISTA associates are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits plan! More information can be found here:

Discover your 100% YOU with MicroSourcing!

Position: Social Media Manager
Work setup & shift: WFH, Day shift

Why join MicroSourcing?

You'll have:

Competitive Rewards: Enjoy above-market compensation, healthcare coverage on day one, plus one or more dependents, paid time-off with cash conversion, group life insurance, and performance bonuses.

A Collaborative Spirit: Contribute to a positive and engaging work environment by participating in company-sponsored events and activities.

Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the balance between work and life that suits you with flexible work arrangements.

Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.

Inclusive Teamwork: Be part of a company that celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive culture.

Your Role:

As a Social Media Manager, you will:

  • Manage and grow Totem's entertainment and creator brands across YouTube, Facebook, and other relevant platforms.
  • Execute channel content and monetization strategies to support audience, engagement, revenue, and profitability targets.
  • Plan content by analysing available IPs, video assets, historical performance, audience behaviour, and emerging content trends.
  • Develop comprehensive video briefs and collaborate with Video Editors to produce engaging, platform-appropriate content.
  • Create compelling titles, descriptions, captions, and supporting copy, and brief/review thumbnails to improve discovery and click-through performance.
  • Publish content accurately while ensuring metadata, links, tags, playlists, and other publishing elements are complete and optimized.
  • Monitor channel monetization and ensure content complies with platform policies and advertiser-friendly requirements.
  • Build and nurture engaged communities by monitoring conversations, responding to comments, and identifying audience insights.
  • Track channel performance, including revenue, views, watch time, retention, engagement, and click-through rate, and use insights to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Contribute to reporting, forecasting, and performance reviews while tracking the impact of content and channel optimizations.
  • Stay informed about social trends, audience behaviour, platform updates, and algorithm changes, translating relevant developments into opportunities for channel growth.
  • Maintain high standards of accuracy, brand consistency, and editorial quality across published content.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams and escalate quality, capacity, delivery, or community risks when required.

What You Need:

Non-negotiables

  • 3+ years of experience in social video, digital publishing, channel management, or a similar role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing YouTube and Facebook channels.
  • Experience contributing to audience, engagement, or revenue growth across social platforms.
  • Strong writing and copywriting skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong understanding of content performance analytics and the ability to use data to inform decisions.
  • Strong visual judgment and the ability to develop or brief effective thumbnails and content packaging.
  • Strong organizational, project-management, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple channels, deadlines, and competing priorities.

Preferred skills/expertise

  • Experience in entertainment, creator, media, or social-first content environments.
  • Knowledge of social video monetization and advertiser-friendly content requirements.
  • Experience with content planning, video briefing, publishing workflows, and metadata optimization.
  • Experience with community management and audience sentiment monitoring.
  • Strong understanding of YouTube, Facebook, and other social platform features, trends, and algorithm changes.
  • Proactive, accountable, solutions-focused, and collaborative working style.
  • Ability to provide clear and constructive feedback to Video Editors and other creative team members.
  • Genuine interest in social-first content, entertainment, creators, and evolving digital platform trends.

Key Performance Indicators

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

  • Achievement of assigned channel audience, engagement, revenue, and performance objectives.
  • Sustainable channel monetization while maintaining compliance with platform and brand requirements.
  • Accurate and timely content preparation, review, and publishing.
  • Effective titles, thumbnails, descriptions, and copy that support discovery and click-through performance.
  • Healthy community engagement and audience sentiment.
  • Timely, evidence-based content and channel optimization.
  • Consistent adherence to Totem's creative, editorial, and brand standards.
  • Clear and effective collaboration with Video Editors and other cross-functional team members.

Job Title: Clinical Research Associate

Job Location: Germany Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.


General Description:


  • The CRA executes clinical monitoring activities at clinical trial sites and monitors clinical trials in accordance with ICH guidelines and GCP, local regulations, and applicable SOPs.
  • Performs monitoring activities related to selection, initiation, conduct (recruitment, quality data collection) and timely completion of oncology/hematology clinical trials within the assigned region.
  • The CRA is responsible for collaborating closely with the Regional Clinical Operations Manager to ensure study timelines are adhered to and required quality standards are maintained.
  • Identify gaps and areas for improvement and propose CAPA.
  • Supports start-up and provides local expertise.
  • SSU experience is considered a plus

CRA activities


  • Perform feasibility, site identification, selection and evaluation, supporting initial list of sites and recruitment targets
  • Provides protocol and related study training to assigned sites.
  • Conducts monitoring (pre-study, initiation, routine monitoring and closeout visits per monitoring plan and applicable SOPs
  • Conducts co-monitoring visits, if required
  • Completes monitoring visit reports in accordance with ICH-GCP, BeOne Medicines standards and SOP
  • Manages sites and site performance by tracking regulatory submissions, recruitment, case report form (CRF) completion, and data query resolution.
  • Establish regular lines of communication with sites and reports site progress, issues and proposed action to Clinical Operations
  • Ensure inspection readiness of the study and sites
  • Collaborates with Regional Clinical Operations Manager and clinical study sites to ensure timely delivery of study milestones (i.e., study startup, recruitment, database analyses, closeout, etc.)
  • Attends disease indication project specific training and general CRA training as required
  • Facilitate Study Oversight Visits (SOVs), site audits and/or inspections, as required
  • Evaluates the quality and integrity of site practices – escalating quality and/or GCP issues with Investigators and internal team as appropriate.
  • Anticipate and identify site issues; propose corrective and preventative actions; identify gaps and utilize opportunities. Constantly strive for operating excellence, question status-quo and promote innovation.

Education Required:


  • BS in a relevant scientific discipline and minimum of 2 years of monitoring experience.
  • Experience in oncology global trials preferred

Other Qualifications:

  • Understands clinical trial processes with a thorough knowledge of ICH and associated regulatory guidelines
  • At least 2 years of (CRA) monitoring experience in the pharmaceutical or CRO industry
  • Experience in oncology/hematology trials preferred
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize and multi-task
  • Fluent in English & German (writing and speaking)

Computer Skills: Efficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, MS Project, MS PowerPoint and Outlook


Travel: up to 60%

Salary Range EU: 55,100.00 EUR - 68,900.00 EUR

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity, and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented

raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web.
Learn more about Pear:

Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data.
Learn more about Keet:

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication.

Requirements

  • Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications.

  • Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar).

  • Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code.

  • Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications.

  • Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems.

  • Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes).

  • Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication.

  • Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management.

  • Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc).

  • Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Ce poste s’inscrit dans notre ligne de produits de surveillance à distance. Pour plus d’information sur nos lignes de produits En qualité de Ingénieur commercial – Ferroviaire , Tunnel et Géotechnique, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la croissance continue des activités d’Eddyfi Technologies – Remote Monitoring Solutions en Europe. Ce poste combine la vente technique, le développement des affaires, le développement de marché et l’engagement client à travers les portefeuilles complémentaires de Senceive et Sisgeo, afin de proposer des solutions intégrées de surveillance pour les applications ferroviaires, souterraines, géotechniques et d’infrastructure. Devenir EDDYFIER, ça vous dit? Chez Eddyfi Technologies, nous sommes fiers de repousser les limites de l’innovation tout en favorisant un milieu de travail où chacun se sent valorisé, respecté et encouragé à donner le meilleur de lui-même. Nous croyons que la diversité des perspectives, des expériences et des façons de penser renforce nos équipes et nous aide à concevoir de meilleures solutions pour les industries dont le monde dépend chaque jour. En tant qu’entreprise de renommée mondiale, nous sommes à l’origine de certains des systèmes les plus avancés au monde — offrant des solutions de pointe en ET/UT, en surveillance à distance, en générateurs de vapeur nucléaires, en systèmes de vision automatisés et en robotique. Nous innovons avec intention, en développant des solutions concrètes et tournées vers l’avenir qui répondent à de vrais enjeux et protègent ce qui compte le plus. Nous sommes fiables et responsables, nous faisons ce que nous disons que nous allons faire. Nous assumons nos actions et livrons des résultats de qualité avec intégrité, constance et transparence. Nous sommes plus forts ensemble et engagés à créer un environnement inclusif où chaque voix est entendue, respectée et soutenue.

Rejoindre notre équipe, c’est :

Collaborer avec des experts dédiés à l’innovation dans un environnement qui valorise la diversité des perspectives, des parcours et des expériences. Se joindre à une organisation qui valorise l’engagement, l’initiative et la collaboration afin d’atteindre des objectifs communs. En tant que Responsable de comptes – Rail, Tunnel et Géotechnique, vous aurez à :

Contribuer activement à la croissance du chiffre d’affaires sur les marchés européens dans les secteurs du ferroviaire, du tunnel et de la géotechnique grâce à la mise en place de stratégie de développement pertinentes Promouvoir le portefeuille combiné de Senceive et Sisgeo en identifiant les opportunités d’intégrer la surveillance sans fil et l’instrumentation géotechnique au sein de solutions complètes. Préparer les soumissions, propositions et réponses aux appels d’offres en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et commerciales internes. Développer des relations de confiance avec les acteurs clés d’infrastructures, les organisations ferroviaires, les entrepreneurs, les entreprises de tunnel, les consultants, les spécialistes en surveillance et les partenaires à travers l’Europe. Comprendre et identifier les enjeux de surveillance des clients et traduire leurs besoins techniques en solutions adaptées de capteurs, communication sans fil, acquisition de données et plateformes de surveillance. Soutenir les présentations techniques, la définition des solutions et le développement des comptes en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de Milton Keynes, Masate et l’ensemble de l’organisation RMS. Représenter Eddyfi Technologies Remote Monitoring Solutions, Senceive et Sisgeo lors de rencontres clients, visites de projets, conférences et événements de l’industrie.

Nous valorisons les compétences transférables, les parcours différents et l’agilité d’apprentissage. L’expérience acquise par des chemins non traditionnels est la bienvenue. Ce qui fait de vous un atout pour notre équipe :

Vous avez une formation technique en génie civil, génie géotechnique, géologie, arpentage ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous avez une expérience confirmée en vente technique, en développement commerciale ou en vente de solutions dans un environnement industriel ou lié aux infrastructures. Vous avez une bonne connaissance d’un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : instrumentation géotechnique ou structurale, systèmes de surveillance sans fil ou automatisés, ferroviaire, tunnels, arpentage, mouvements structuraux, grandes infrastructures civiles ou géorisques. Vous savez identifier les enjeux techniques des clients afin de traduire leurs besoins en solutions adaptées et en mode projet Vous maîtrisez l’anglais à un niveau professionnel; toute autre langue européenne constitue un atout. Vous êtes animé(e) à l'idée de voyager régulièrement à travers l’Europe. Vous êtes capable d’évoluer efficacement dans un environnement international, collaboratif et en télétravail selon les besoins.

Pourquoi rejoindre Eddyfi ? Que ce nous t’offrons :

L’occasion de jouer un rôle stratégique dans la croissance de nos activités Remote Monitoring Solutions en Europe. Un poste flexible en télétravail, basé n’importe où en Europe. Une exposition à des technologies innovantes combinant surveillance à distance sans fil, instrumentation géotechnique et solutions intégrées de données. Une collaboration avec des équipes internationales expérimentées et des marques reconnues comme Senceive et Sisgeo. La possibilité d’avoir un impact concret dans les secteurs des infrastructures, du rail, du tunnel et de la géotechnique.

Si vous avez besoin de mesures d’adaptation à quelque étape que ce soit du processus de recrutement, veuillez nous en informer. Bewerbungsfrist 19.09.2026

Für die Betreuung und Mitarbeit in einem öffentlich geförderten Projekt suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine:n Projektmanager:in Klimaschutztechnologien & Gebäudeenergiemanagement (m|w|d).

Über das Projekt

Das geförderte Vorhaben zielt darauf ab, die traditionsreiche Metallverarbeitungsindustrie im Bergischen Land mit aufstrebenden Cleantech-Innovatoren zu verknüpfen, um im Bereich des Gebäudeenergiemanagements sowohl von privaten als auch industriell genutzten Bauwerken einen Transformationsprozess anzustoßen. Das Konsortium besteht aus wissenschaftlichen Instituten, öffentlichen Einrichtungen und mittelständischen, produzierenden Unternehmen.
FCA verantwortet innerhalb des Konsortiums zwei Unterprojekte, die sich auf regionale Innovatoren konzentrieren, deren Ansätze im systemischen Kontext für Energiebedarfe von Gebäuden skaliert werden können:

  • Thermische Speicher-Technologie auf Carnot-Batterie-Basis systemische Integration in kommunale und industrielle Nutzung von Prozesswärme, Raumwärme und Elektrizität, inkl. Betrachtung der Wärme- und Kältebedarfe von Gebäuden.
  • Konstruktive Effizienz und modulare Leichtbauweise Entwicklung eines neuen Designstandards zur Tragwerksleistung unter Betrachtung aller Energieströme und Emissionen über den gesamten Lebenszyklus (Errichtung, Nutzung, Abriss, Wiederverwertung).
Verantwortlichkeiten

Die Projektmanager:in betreut die beiden oben genannten FCA-Unterprojekte fachlich und organisatorisch und ist zentrale Ansprechperson für die beteiligten Unternehmenspartner. Wesentliche Aufgaben umfassen:

  • Fachliche und organisatorische Betreuung der Unterprojekte "Thermische Speicher-Technologie auf Carnot-Batterie-Basis" und "Konstruktive Effizienz und modulare Leichtbauweise" in enger Abstimmung mit den technischen Partnern.
  • Fachliche Einordnung und Weiterentwicklung der Analysen zur energetischen Bewertung von Gebäuden (Beheizung, Kühlung, Lüftung, Warmwasserbereitung, Beleuchtung) sowie zum Energiemanagement, aufbauend auf bestehenden, industriell ausgerichteten Prozessanalysen.
  • Anfertigung technischer Zwischen- und Abschlussberichte unter Anleitung der Projektleitung, inkl. Aufbereitung technischer Inhalte für den Fördermittelgeber.
  • Übernahme administrativer und berichtsrelevanter Aufgaben im Rahmen des Projektreportings, in Abstimmung mit dem Operations-Team.
  • Vernetzung von etablierter Industrie mit innovativen Lösungsansätzen von Start-Ups und weiteren Cleantech-Akteuren, um Investitionen und Folgeprojekte auch über die Projektlaufzeit hinaus anzustoßen.
  • Koordination mit Konsortialpartnern aus Wissenschaft, öffentlichen Einrichtungen und mittelständischen Unternehmen.
  • Verankerung von FCAs Mission zur Schließung der Innovationslücken innerhalb des Projektes.
  • Gelegentliche Reisen zu Konsortialtreffen und Vor-Ort-Terminen nach Remscheid (ca. 2–4 Mal pro Jahr).

erforderliche qualifikationen | expertise

  • Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, z. B. im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, Energietechnik, Gebäudetechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit an und Umsetzung von öffentlich geförderten Projekten, idealerweise inkl. technischem Reporting gegenüber Fördermittelgebern.
  • Grundverständnis von Gebäudeenergiemanagement (Beheizung, Kühlung, Lüftung, Warmwasserbereitung, Beleuchtung) sowie idealerweise Kenntnisse zu thermischen Speichertechnologien und/oder konstruktiver Gebäudeeffizienz.
  • Fähigkeit, technische Inhalte klar und adressatengerecht in Zwischen- und Abschlussberichten aufzubereiten.
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Industrieunternehmen, KMU oder wissenschaftlichen Partnern von Vorteil.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Bereitschaft, administrative Reporting-Aufgaben mitzuübernehmen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Wohnsitz in Deutschland zwingend erforderlich, idealerweise in Nordrhein-Westfalen; andernfalls Bereitschaft zu 2–4 Dienstreisen pro Jahr nach Remscheid.

vergütung

FCA bietet ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, das der jeweiligen Berufserfahrung sowie den entsprechenden Zulagen entspricht.

arbeitsstunden | mobile arbeit

Die Position ist als Remote-Tätigkeit aus Deutschland angelegt. Gelegentliche Präsenz vor Ort in Remscheid (ca. 2–4 Mal pro Jahr) ist Teil der Rolle.

vertragsdauer | starttermin

Die Stelle ist befristet auf die Laufzeit des Projekts, mit der klaren Absicht einer anschließenden Verlängerung. Der frühestmögliche Starttermin ist so bald wie möglich.

Provide high-quality casework and administrative support for the final ombudsman-style stage of a new standardised process for complaints about how safeguarding concerns have been handled by Church of England bodies. Act as the first point of contact for enquiries and complaints, ensuring information is managed accurately, cases are progressed efficiently, and service users receive a professional, responsive and supportive service.

Description

The Church of England’s Safeguarding Structures Reform Programme is delivering a programme to strengthen safeguarding and rebuild trust. The Programme will roll out a standardised process across Church of England bodies for complaints about how safeguarding matters have been handled. Where matters cannot be resolved locally, they can be referred to an independent complaints body to review and make a final determination.

The Case Support Officer is responsible for providing administrative and operational support across the complaints service. The role acts as a key point of contact for enquiries, supports the progression of complaints through the process, maintains accurate records, prepares correspondence and documentation, and ensures case management systems are up to date.

The postholder will work closely with complaints reviewers, managers and external stakeholders to provide an efficient, professional and high-quality service. They will contribute to continuous improvement, support effective case management and help ensure that service users receive timely and accurate information throughout the complaints process.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Acting as a first point of contact for enquiries received by telephone, email, online forms and correspondence.
  • Providing information about the complaints process, eligibility requirements and timescales.
  • Registering enquiries and complaints and maintaining accurate case records within the case management system.
  • Reviewing incoming documentation, identifying missing information and seeking additional information where required.
  • Preparing standard correspondence, notices, acknowledgements and other case-related documentation.
  • Supporting the administration and progression of complaints throughout the complaints handling process.
  • Managing electronic and paper records in accordance with information governance and confidentiality requirements.
  • Supporting the administration of subject access requests and other information rights enquiries, including locating, collating and preparing records in accordance with information governance, data protection and confidentiality requirements.
  • Producing management information, reports and statistical data as required.
  • Supporting complaint reviewers and managers with case administration and operational activities.
  • Building constructive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Contributing to service improvement initiatives and the development of administrative processes and procedures.
  • Supporting organisational objectives and promoting good practice, equality and inclusion.

Requirements

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Experience in an administrative, customer service, casework support or complaints handling environment.
  • Experience of managing information accurately and maintaining records and databases.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload and manage competing demands.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work professionally and sensitively with people who may be distressed or dissatisfied.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and accuracy.
  • Experience of using case management, customer relationship management (CRM) or similar systems.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and build effective working relationships.
  • Sound judgement, discretion and ability to handle confidential information appropriately.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement, equality, diversity and inclusion.
  • Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications and case management systems.

Desirable

  • Experience supporting complaint handling, investigations, regulatory, safeguarding or ombudsman services.
  • Experience preparing reports, statistics or management information.
  • Understanding of complaint handling principles and customer service standards.
  • Experience of applying trauma-informed principles in practice.
  • Experience working in a public sector, charity, regulatory or ecclesiastical environment.

raw.title: Senior VA Health Systems Integration & Interoperability Specialist
raw.excerpt: OverviewLMI is seeking a Senior VA Health Systems Integration & Interoperability Specialist to support Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives requiring reliable movement of clinical, operational, referral, authorization, and Community Care information.
raw.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Senior VA Health Systems Integration & Interoperability Specialist to support Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives requiring reliable movement of clinical, operational, referral, authorization, and Community Care information. This role is for a deeply experienced VA technologist who can connect integration decisions to real Veteran-care workflows.

The specialist will serve as a senior lead across VistA/CPRS, Oracle Health/Federal EHR, Integrated Veteran Care (IVC), Veterans Community Care (VCC), Community Care Referral and Authorization (CCRA), and HealthShare Referral Manager (HSRM). The role will trace data and workflow across direct and community care, identify authoritative sources, and resolve interface and reconciliation issues. The candidate must understand how consults/referrals, authorizations, episodes of care, clinical documentation, eligibility, scheduling, provider information, and returned Community Care records move through VA workflows, including differences in terminology, identifiers, statuses, and business rules across legacy and modern platforms.

The role will partner with VA clinical and operational stakeholders, IVC/Community Care teams, health informatics, data engineering, architecture, cybersecurity/privacy, analytics, and delivery teams to troubleshoot integrations, define mappings, support migration/reconciliation, and validate data used for analytics, automation, AI-enabled solutions, and decision support.

The ideal candidate brings substantial direct VA/VHA experience, deep VistA expertise, meaningful Oracle Health/Cerner experience, and a record of integrating complex federal health systems. This is not a generic ETL role; VA-specific system and workflow knowledge is essential.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior technical lead for VA health-system integration across VistA/CPRS, Oracle Health/Federal EHR, IVC/VCC Community Care, and related enterprise data flows.
  • Map and troubleshoot end-to-end direct-care and Community Care workflows, including consults/referrals, authorizations, scheduling, episodes of care, documentation, provider data, and returned medical records.
  • Examine healthcare claims and data in X-12 data standards and formats to aggregate encounters and episodic data to identify objective healthcare outcomes and payment metrics
  • Reconcile VistA/CPRS consult workflows with Oracle Health referral workflows, including statuses, identifiers, business rules, and reporting impacts.
  • Support CCRA/HSRM integration for Community Care referrals and authorizations and isolate workflow, interface, configuration, and data-quality issues.
  • Design and review source-to-target mappings, interface specifications, transformation rules, reconciliation logic, and validation criteria across approved VA and community-care exchanges.
  • Evaluate VA integration approaches including VIA, RPC/RPC Broker patterns, HL7 v2, APIs, FHIR-based exchange, files, databases, and other approved mechanisms.
  • Trace authoritative sources and lineage across VistA, Oracle Health, Community Care, enterprise repositories, and downstream analytics; resolve conflicting definitions and records.
  • Diagnose failed or incomplete integrations by examining interface behavior, timing, identifiers, code sets, status transitions, missingness, duplicates, permissions, and dependencies.
  • Support VistA-to-Federal-EHR coexistence, migration, cutover, and reconciliation by validating mappings, completeness, interface behavior, and continuity of critical data.
  • Enable reporting, measurement, automation, and AI-enabled workflows while preserving source context, lineage, validation, and known limitations.
  • Coordinate with clinical informatics, IVC/Community Care SMEs, application owners, architecture, platform, cybersecurity/privacy, data teams, and Government stakeholders to resolve cross-system issues.
  • Define monitoring, exception handling, auditability, data-quality checks, interface-health indicators, and operational support expectations for critical integrations.
  • Produce system/data-flow diagrams, interface inventories, mappings, business-rule crosswalks, lineage, reconciliation logic, known limitations, and operational dependencies.
  • Provide senior technical review, mentoring, and knowledge transfer on VA-specific integration constraints, workflows, and authoritative sources.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, health informatics, data engineering, engineering, or a related field; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered
  • 10+ years healthcare claims review and processing specifically with Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transactions and data in X-12 formats, with emphasis on 270/271 transactions in operations, development, subrogation/subvention, and/or fraud/waste/abuse capacities.
  • 5+ years in healthcare systems integration, health IT, data integration, interoperability, EHR integration, or related enterprise technology work.
  • 5+ years of direct VA/VHA technology, health informatics, integration, data, or Community Care experience with practical knowledge of VA systems and workflows.
  • Deep hands-on VistA/CPRS expertise, including architecture, data structures, workflows, and integration approaches such as FileMan concepts, RPC/RPC Broker, HL7, VIA, or comparable mechanisms.
  • Demonstrated Oracle Health/Cerner or Federal EHR experience spanning VistA coexistence, interfaces, migration, reconciliation, or workflow translation.
  • Strong VA Community Care and IVC/VCC knowledge, including referral/authorization lifecycles and experience with CCRA/HSRM or closely related integration processes.
  • Strong SQL skills for investigating complex issues across relational databases, enterprise data stores, interface outputs, and reporting environments.
  • Experience with HL7 v2, APIs, JSON/XML, FHIR concepts, ETL/ELT, batch/file exchange, identity matching, and source-to-target mapping.
  • Demonstrated ability to reconcile conflicting records, identifiers, statuses, definitions, and business rules and determine the authoritative source for a use case.
  • Experience handling PHI/PII within federal healthcare security, privacy, auditing, records-management, access-control, and data-governance requirements.
  • Ability to successfully complete and maintain required federal background investigation, suitability, and Public Trust requirements.

Desired:

  • 12+ years of enterprise health IT or systems-integration experience with extensive VA/VHA work across facilities, VISNs, national program offices, or enterprise systems.
  • Deep IVC/VCC Community Care experience, including CCRA/HSRM, Community Care Network workflows, referral/authorization status, episodes of care, eligibility, scheduling, and clinical-document return.
  • Experience with VA Community Care data environments such as CCRA, CCRS, eCAMS, CDW, or other governed enterprise sources.
  • Experience with JLV, Health Information Exchange (HIE), or other VA mechanisms for exchanging or viewing clinical information across VA, federal, and community partners.
  • Familiarity with M/MUMPS, InterSystems technologies, VistA FileMan, or low-level VistA troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting Federal EHR modernization, VistA-to-Oracle Health migration/coexistence, interface remediation, or cross-EHR data reconciliation.
  • Experience enabling analytics, automation, AI/ML, or decision support using VA clinical or Community Care data with appropriate lineage, validation, and human oversight.
  • Relevant interoperability, health informatics, HL7/FHIR, cloud/data integration, database, or architecture training/certification; deep VA expertise is more important than any single credential.

Target Salary Range: $125,000 - $200,000

Disclaimer:

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.
