raw.description:
Position Overview
The European Carrier Sales Director is a senior individual contributor and regional leader responsible for driving carrier and service provider revenue across the European market. This role owns the full sales cycle for carrier partnerships — from prospecting and qualification through close — and serves as the primary relationship executive for European telecom carriers, service providers, and channel partners. The Director will represent NUWAVE’s full product portfolio (iPILOT, TELEPORT, SYNTHESIS, Pulsar, CONSTELLATION, and All Marketplace Solutions) and will work in close coordination with US-based sales leadership and cross-functional teams to deliver consistent, scalable revenue growth in the region.
Reports To: VP of Global Channels and Alliances (Travis A. Burris)
Location: Europe (Remote / Field-Based)
Territory: United Kingdom, Western Europe, and EMEA expansion markets
Mission
Drive strategic carrier and service provider alliances across Europe by identifying, recruiting, and developing high-value partnerships that expand NUWAVE’s footprint in the Microsoft Teams, Webex Calling, and Zoom Phone ecosystems. Deliver consistent revenue growth through disciplined pipeline management, deep product expertise, and trusted partner relationships.
Key Responsibilities
Partner Development & Revenue Growth
  • Recruit and onboard new European carrier and service provider partners to expand NUWAVE’s regional presence and increase recurring revenue.
  • Achieve consistent year-over-year revenue growth within existing European channel relationships.
  • Develop and execute territory business plans aligned to NUWAVE’s global sales strategy and revenue targets.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from lead generation through contract execution for carrier and service provider accounts.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the European UC and cloud communications market.

Pipeline & Forecast Management
  • Own and maintain an accurate, up-to-date sales pipeline for the European territory in HubSpot CRM.
  • Provide monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts to sales leadership.
  • Track deal progression through all pipeline stages and ensure timely advancement with documented gate criteria.
  • Identify at-risk deals early and develop mitigation strategies in collaboration with leadership.
Market Intelligence & Strategy
  • Monitor European telecom market trends, regulatory developments (e.g., GDPR, BEREC), and competitive landscape.
  • Analyze competitor activities and provide actionable intelligence to product and marketing teams.
  • Identify emerging opportunities in Microsoft Teams Operator Connect, Direct Routing, and cloud UC adoption across European markets.
  • Develop regional go-to-market strategies in partnership with marketing and product leadership.
Partner Enablement & Education
  • Educate carrier and service provider partners on NUWAVE’s full product suite, including iPILOT, TELEPORT, SYNTHESIS, Pulsar, and CONSTELLATION.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations, presentations, and proposals tailored to the needs of European carriers.
  • Collaborate with NUWAVE Academy to ensure partners complete onboarding and ongoing training requirements.
  • Represent NUWAVE at European industry events, tradeshows, and partner conferences (e.g., MWC, UC EXPO, Channel Live).

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Coordinate with the Service Assurance and UC Engineering teams to ensure smooth partner onboarding and service delivery.
  • Work with the NUWAVE order management and provisioning teams to support European time-zone order types (UK and EMEA).
  • Collaborate with US-based carrier sales managers (Eric Egan, Jason Shepperd) to align on global carrier strategy and avoid channel conflict.
  • Partner with the NUWAVE marketing team on regional campaigns, co-marketing initiatives, and promotional activities.
  • Escalate and resolve partner issues — including pricing conflicts, service disputes, and technical concerns — promptly and professionally.
Operational Excellence
  • Document all customer and partner communications in HubSpot CRM; follow up on all calls and meetings with written summaries.
  • Adhere to NUWAVE’s deal creation and stage-advancement standards, including MRR documentation, contact association, and next-step capture.
  • Participate in regular sales cadence calls with US leadership, adjusting for time zone as needed.
  • Maintain compliance with NUWAVE communication guidelines and OOO protocols while traveling and on PTO.
Qualifications
Required
  • 7+ years of enterprise or carrier sales experience in the telecommunications or cloud communications industry.
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a European or EMEA territory.
  • Deep knowledge of the European telecom carrier landscape, including Tier 1 and Tier 2 operators.
  • Experience selling Microsoft Teams, Webex Calling, Zoom Phone, or equivalent UCaaS/CPaaS solutions.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Operator Connect, Direct Routing, and SIP trunking architectures.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage C-level and VP-level stakeholders at carrier organizations.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (HubSpot preferred) and pipeline management disciplines.
  • Fluent English required; additional European language(s) strongly preferred (German, French, Dutch, or Nordic languages).
Preferred
  • Experience with OSS/BSS platforms and carrier-grade network integration.
  • Familiarity with NUWAVE’s product portfolio or comparable CPaaS/UCaaS management platforms.
  • Existing relationships with European telecom carriers, MNOs, or Microsoft channel partners.
  • Experience working in a US-headquartered company with a remote European presence.
  • Knowledge of GDPR and European data privacy regulations as they apply to cloud communications.

Core Values Alignment
  • Collaboration — Works cross-functionally with US teams, engineering, and service assurance to deliver for partners.
  • Trust — Builds long-term carrier relationships grounded in transparency and reliability.
  • Respect — Honors diverse European business cultures and communication styles.
  • Diversity — Brings varied regional perspectives that drive innovation in NUWAVE’s go-to-market approach.
About NUWAVE Communications
NUWAVE Communications is a cloud communications provider with 25+ years of experience delivering telecommunications services worldwide. Our flagship platform, iPILOT, is the industry’s leading CPaaS solution for unified communications lifecycle management — enabling carriers, service providers, and enterprises to provision, manage, and automate deployments of Microsoft Teams, Webex Calling, and Zoom Phone at scale. NUWAVE is a certified Microsoft Teams Operator Connect provider with a geo-redundant, carrier-grade global network and a 10+ year record of zero customer-facing outages.

We're currently expanding our team globally, join our global team in our new journey now!

We are hiring Treasury Accountant for Future Group Finance Team.

﻿Job Summary:﻿

﻿A Treasury Accountant is responsible for managing and optimizing an organization's cash flows, ensuring accurate financial records, and mitigating financial risks. They handle various treasury activities, including cash management, bank reconciliations, cash forecasting, debt management, and financial reporting. With a focus on maintaining liquidity, maximizing interest income, and minimizing borrowing costs, Treasury Accountants play a crucial role in supporting financial decision-making and maintaining the financial health of the organization. Strong financial acumen, analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication are key attributes for success in this role. Compliance with financial regulations, ethical conduct, and a commitment to continuous learning are also essential.

Job Description:

Cash Management: Monitor and manage cash flows, including cash receipts, disbursements, and banking transactions. Ensure proper cash positioning and liquidity management to meet operational needs while maximizing interest income and minimizing borrowing costs.

Bank Reconciliation: Perform regular bank reconciliations to ensure accurate recording of cash transactions and reconcile any discrepancies. Monitor bank balances, resolve banking issues, and maintain effective relationships with financial institutions.

Cash Forecasting: Develop and maintain cash flow forecasts to project cash requirements and optimize cash management. Analyze cash flow trends, identify potential shortfalls or surpluses, and provide recommendations for cash planning and investment decisions.

Treasury Reporting: Prepare timely and accurate treasury reports, including cash flow statements, debt schedules, bank reconciliations, and other financial reports. Provide analysis and commentary on variances, trends, and key metrics to support decision-making.

Risk Management: Assist in identifying and mitigating financial risks related to treasury operations. Monitor interest rate risk, foreign exchange risk, and credit risk. Develop and implement risk management strategies and procedures.

Compliance and Regulations: Ensure compliance with relevant financial regulations, accounting standards, and internal controls. Stay updated on changes in financial regulations and assess their impact on treasury operations. Assist in internal and external audits related to treasury activities.

Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate with internal stakeholders such as finance, accounting, and operations teams to gather information, coordinate treasury activities, and provide support. Communicate effectively with banks, financial institutions, and external parties regarding treasury-related matters.

Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation within treasury operations. Streamline workflows, enhance controls, and implement best practices to optimize efficiency and effectiveness.

Om Lawgent

Lawgent är en modern juristbyrå för företag som verkar där juridik, AI, data och europeisk reglering möts. Vi arbetar med bland annat AI och data, GDPR, digital reglering, finansiell reglering och kommersiell juridik, och gör komplex juridik tydlig och användbar. Nu växer vi i hela Sverige.

Du kan bo och arbeta var som helst i landet: vi arbetar digitalt och träffar klienter på plats när det behövs.

Om rollen

Du ser till att Lawgent vinner offentliga upphandlingar i Sverige. Du bevakar, väljer ut och besvarar upphandlingar inom våra affärsområden, som juridisk rådgivning, dataskydd, AI-reglering och juristkonsulter.

Det här är en säljroll: varje vunnen upphandling är en affär.

Det här gör du

  • Bevakar upphandlingar och ramavtal hos myndigheter, kommuner och regioner

  • Bedömer vilka upphandlingar vi ska lägga anbud på

  • Har erfarenhet av offentlig upphandling, anbudsskrivning eller försäljning till offentlig sektor

  • Är noggrann, strukturerad och håller deadlines

  • Tar egna initiativ och har affärssinne

  • Talar och skriver svenska obehindrat och har god engelska

Det är meriterande om du

  • Har kunskap om LOU

  • Har erfarenhet från juridik eller konsultbranschen

Varför Lawgent

  • Obegränsad intjäning: din inkomst växer med de affärer du skapar, utan tak

  • Du arbetar med AI- och EU-reglering, ett av de snabbast växande områdena inom juridiken

  • Internationell räckvidd med klienter och partners i Europa, Mellanöstern, Nordamerika och Asien

  • Samarbete med internationella experter, bland annat professor Douwe Korff

I ansökan svarar du på några frågor och spelar in en kort video där du presenterar dig. Vi läser alla svar innan vi bokar intervjuer.

Skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida. Alla rekryteringar till Lawgent hanteras genom Nordic Investin Groups gemensamma karriärportal.

raw.description:
Description

TripleTen is a service that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions.

Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career.

Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

TripleTen is a remote first organization mirroring our students who complete our bootcamps in a remote environment

We are looking for a high energy, consultative Technical Senior Sales Consultant to work with a more advanced audience: experienced tech professionals who already work in the industry and are looking to deepen their expertise, switch specializations, or move into senior and higher paying roles. This is a step above our core B2C sales team. You'll be selling an advanced program to experienced engineers, so you need to hold a credible, peer-level conversation and be comfortable across the full arc of modern systems engineering (system design and architecture, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems and data, security, and production AI). You won't need to write code, but you must understand these concepts well enough to answer real questions, map the curriculum to the roles and salaries candidates are targeting, and earn the trust of people who have hands-on experience.

The best candidates for this position combine strong consultative sales skills with genuine comfort in technical conversations, and thrive on complex, high value deals rather than high volume transactional sales.

What you will do

  • Operate as a full cycle sales consultant, engaging technically experienced prospects, qualifying their goals, and guiding them to a decision
  • Hold credible, informed conversations about technical topics relevant to our advanced courses, without needing to defer every technical question elsewhere
  • Present and articulate TripleTen's value proposition for career advancement and skill deepening, tailored to an audience that already has industry experience
  • Work closely with sales leadership to close complex, higher ticket deals and consistently meet or exceed quota
  • Work closely with marketing to refine messaging and positioning for this more experienced audience
  • Maintain accurate documentation of leads and pipeline progress using HubSpot
  • Bring consultative rigor and technical credibility to a team built around trust and expertise

﻿Weekly Schedule:

11:00 AM - 8:00 PM (EST) Monday to Thursday, 9:00 AM (EST) - 6:00 PM (EST) rotating Friday or Saturday

Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of sales experience in complex, consultative, or high-ticket sales environments (B2B and B2C, EdTech, enterprise software, complex technical products, or similar)
  • Some technical background or working knowledge of the tech industry (former engineers, IT sales professionals, or similar) is strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated record of hitting sales and activity quota consistently in previous roles
  • Strong discovery skills - able to diagnose a prospect's goals and gaps before pitching, not lead with a script.
  • Comfortable closing high-ticket deals and handling price and financing objections (payment plans, financing options)
  • Ability to build credibility and rapport with technically experienced prospects
  • Sharp business acumen, prior experience using HubSpot preferred
  • Fluent English (C1 or above)
  • Passionate about helping experienced professionals advance their careers
  • Excellent team member who puts the mission above themselves (is focused more on "getting things right" rather than having to "be right")

What we can offer you

  • Base Compensation: $2,000/month + uncapped commission based on hitting monthly cash-in quota. Total monthly earnings typically range from $6,000 to $8,000+ for consistent performers, with no cap on top results.
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom — to make working together seamless
  • Growth. Our product is expanding quickly, so it's a great time to get on board and challenge yourself
  • Internationally distributed team. Exceptional teammates, who love what they do

Disclosures

*This description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time.

**TripleTen is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national original, age, religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor.

raw.excerpt: Crum & Forster Company OverviewCrum & Forster (C&F) provides market leading property & casualty, accident & health, specialty and standard commercial lines insurance solutions.
raw.description:
Crum & Forster Company Overview

Crum & Forster (C&F) provides market leading property & casualty, accident & health, specialty and standard commercial lines insurance solutions. A true underwriting company, we have a 200-year history of helping our customers manage risk with laser-focused expertise, integrity and discipline. Our people are empowered to make decisions and problem-solve with you smartly and swiftly. Our annual gross written premium is 6.2 billion. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best.

Our most valuable asset is our people. We have 3000 employees, and locations throughout the United States and India. With our employee-first focus, the Company is consistently recognized as a great place to work, earning multiple workplace and wellness awards, including the Great Place to Work® Award, Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For, Fortune Best Workplaces for Parents, Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials, and many others.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings. For more information about C&F, please visit our website: www.cfins.com

Job Description

C&F’s Commercial Lines division delivers specialized insurance solutions for mid-sized and large businesses across a broad range of commercial exposures, management liabilities, and industry segments.

Our portfolio includes tailored coverage solutions for General Liability, Commercial Auto, Workers’ Compensation, Property, and Excess Liability, as well as Financial Lines products such as Management Liability, Professional Liability, Cyber, Crime, and Fidelity.

With more than 700 employees across the United States, Commercial Lines combines deep underwriting expertise, disciplined risk selection, and the strength of C&F’s national platform. We work closely with our customers and distribution partners to provide responsive service, thoughtful risk solutions, and the confidence to navigate complex business challenges.

Senior Underwriter Job Summary - This role can be fully remote in the Continental US.

The Middle Market Solutions department at Crum & Forster is looking to scale growth and achieve larger market share in the P&C space. With almost a decade of growth, a strong core team backed by a unique no-ego, entrepreneurial culture, and a book and regional footprint well established, we are now looking to expand our team. This role housed under the home office, will work cohesively with regional management teams to underwrite complex property opportunities generated out of the various regions by the regional underwriters. We are seeking an experienced property or package underwriter with market-facing background and an entrepreneurial spirit to join our quest for the next level of profitable growth. This individual will be a team player with extensive property underwriting experience, working collaboratively with regional production underwriters to build our large complex property book while directly working with the regional brokers. They will review and analyze underwriting data to select superior property risks and build/maintain a profitable book of business with target broker shops by working on their complex/large property accounts. They will develop and manage agency relationships through superior customer service, and innovation. They will collaborate with colleagues and maintain strong relationships internally and externally to achieve book profitability and growth goals. We are seeking a dynamic independent individual who thrives in an entrepreneurial culture and values a team based environment rooted in solution orientation enabled through strong knowledge of fire/CAT exposures inherent to target Middle Market operations/locations.

  • Will be the complex property contact for the regional brokers and tasked with working directly with regional managers and regional production underwriters.
  • Responsible for achieving the large property broker goal, exhibiting close collaboration with assigned regional production underwriter (who is also the relationship lead for the broker).
  • Exhibit very high technical skills for underwriting property risks while maintaining a strong understanding of the company’s appetite/treaty.
  • Ability to creatively craft property program structures with the backdrop of prevailing treaty requirements and company’s tolerance for CAT exposures.
  • Meet profitability, retention, and written premium goals determined by the department.
  • Ability to work creatively on property accounts while working collaboratively with the risk engineering team.
  • Strong attention to detail and a strong mix of analytical and people skills .
  • Make independent decisions within underwriting letter of authority and maintain proper file documentation while exhibiting timely communication with home office on referral points outside of the authority letter.
  • Stay abreast of property market nuances to be able to respond to any market disruptions/changes.
  • Actively seek out large property business growth opportunities with regional brokers
  • Have in-depth knowledge of department property product, services and processes
  • Participate in training and initiatives to develop property knowledge base. May participate in projects and national strategy.
  • Travel may be required on occasion.
  • Other duties as assigned.

· Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and and 6+ years of underwriting experience preferred.

· Strong technical property underwriting expertise

· Strong understanding of CAT exposures, CAT deductibles and CAT aggregations.

· Strong market facing experience

· Innovative and entrepreneurial spirit and a flexible, dynamic approach to the business willing to embrace the forward looking AI assisted underwriting environment

  • Knowledge of exposures as related to property line, within Manufacturing, Retail, Wholesale, Real Estate, Hospitality and other general industry risks.

· Strong communication and analytical skills to pursue new business and manage a renewal book.

· Proficient in software needed to succeed in department.

· Knowledge and experience in dealing with territory specific broker relationships.

· Excellent organizational and time management skills.

What C&F will bring to you

At C&F you will BELONG

We value inclusivity and diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you require special accommodation, please let us know.

For California Residents Only: Information collected and processed as part of your career profile and any job applications you choose to submit are subject to our privacy notices and policies, visit for more information.

Crum & Forster is committed to ensuring a workplace free from discriminatory pay disparities and complying with applicable pay equity laws. Salary ranges are available for all positions at this location, taking into account roles with a comparable level of responsibility and impact in the relevant labor market and these salary ranges are regularly reviewed and adjusted in accordance with prevailing market conditions. The annualized base pay for the advertised position, located in the specified area, ranges from a minimum of $78,600 to a maximum of $147,700. The actual compensation is determined by various factors, including but not limited to the market pay for the jobs at each level, the responsibilities and skills required for each job, and the employee’s contribution (performance) in that role. To be considered within market range, a salary is at or above the minimum of the range. You may also have the opportunity to participate in discretionary equity (stock) based compensation and/or performance-based variable pay programs.

  • Flexible work arrangements.
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Generous 401K employer match.
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching.
  • Generous Paid Time Off.
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our Wellness programs focus on your family’s complete wellness, including your physical and mental wellbeing
  • A core C&F principle is that you manage your career. To support your development, we have a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry related certifications and professional training available to you.
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment.
  • A spirit of social responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee driven corporate giving.

raw.description:
Our client is a leading financial services organization supporting businesses with commercial payment solutions. They are seeking a Supplier Enablement Specialist to help business customers transition supplier payments from traditional paper checks to electronic payment methods, including commercial card and ACH.

In this role, you will conduct supplier outreach, explain approved electronic payment options, facilitate enrollment, and coordinate with business customers and internal teams to resolve questions and manage exceptions. The ideal candidate brings direct supplier enablement experience, professional phone and email communication skills, and the ability to manage a high volume of cases accurately while supporting broader payment conversion goals.

The Details:

  • Location: Remote (must be able to work across U.S. time zones)
  • Duration: Approximately a 12-month consulting role with the possibility of extension (must be able to work on Blend’s W2 without sponsorship)
  • Benefits: We do offer benefits to our full-time consultants, including Health, Vision, Dental, 401K plan, Life Insurance, Pretax Commuter Benefits, and an incredibly supportive team cheering you on!

What you’ll do:

Supplier Outreach & Electronic Payment Conversion

  • Conduct proactive outbound phone and email outreach to suppliers assigned to payment conversion campaigns.
  • Explain approved electronic payment options, their benefits, and applicable program requirements.
  • Communicate with each business customer's payment strategy and relevant operating guidelines clearly and professionally.
  • Answer supplier questions, address common concerns, and help suppliers understand the steps required to adopt electronic payment methods.
  • Manage follow-up activities to move each supplier through enrollment, closure, or formal handoff.
  • Support campaign objectives by encouraging supplier participation and adoption of electronic payment solutions.

Supplier Research & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Review assigned supplier records and verify available contact information and payment details.
  • Research supplier questions and provide timely, accurate responses within established guidelines.
  • Coordinate communication among business customers, suppliers, and internal financial institution teams.
  • Identify questions or situations that fall outside standard procedures and route them to the appropriate team.
  • Escalate commercial, technical, policy, compliance, and other nonstandard issues as needed.

Enrollment, Documentation & Case Management

  • Enroll suppliers when their circumstances align with established operating procedures and approved guidelines.
  • Identify exceptions and route nonstandard enrollment requests to the designated team for review and resolution.
  • Maintain accurate records of supplier outreach, responses, enrollment progress, follow-up requirements, and final case status.
  • Track assigned cases through completion or handoff, ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-through.
  • Provide accurate activity data to support monthly reporting, campaign tracking, and overall program performance.
  • Manage multiple supplier cases and follow-up activities while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and attention to detail.

Compliance & Quality

  • Follow applicable policies, procedures, operating guides, regulatory requirements, and quality standards.
  • Apply approved solutions consistently and recognize when additional review or escalation is required.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation in a regulated financial services environment.
  • Balance productivity and responsiveness with careful execution across repetitive, high-volume workflows.
  • Work independently while following client priorities, established processes, and escalation procedures.

Education & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in client service, sales, operations, financial services, payments, or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of direct supplier enablement experience supporting electronic payment adoption.
  • Professional outbound calling or sales experience, including the ability to communicate effectively with business contacts.
  • Experience in supporting supplier onboarding, business payments, commercial cards, ACH, Treasury Management, accounts payable, or payment conversion initiatives is preferred.
  • Experience working with a bank, payment provider, fintech organization, or large corporate payments program is a plus.
  • Experience in a regulated or compliance-driven environment is preferred.

Technical & Operational Skills

  • Moderate Microsoft Excel proficiency, including formulas, filtering, sorting, and formatting.
  • Experience using CRM systems, call-tracking platforms, workflow tools, or case-management systems.
  • Ability to review records, research questions, apply approved solutions, and maintain accurate documentation.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple cases, follow-ups, and competing priorities.
  • Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

Communication & Professional Skills

  • Strong verbal communication skills and a professional, confident telephone manner.
  • Clear and effective business email writing and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to explain processes and payment options in straightforward, easy-to-understand terms.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the judgment to distinguish routine questions from issues requiring escalation.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with suppliers, business customers, and internal teams.
  • Reliable follow-through, attention to detail, and a consistent focus on service quality and campaign goals.

The starting pay rate for this role is $40.00 per hour. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 also offers a competitive benefits program to meet the health and financial well-being of our team and their families. You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs.

A diverse workforce is a strong workforce
To deliver growth at BLEND360 and for our clients, we believe as a Talent Solutions Company, we have a responsibility and unique opportunity to positively impact the workforce. Diversity has played a critical role in our history, our growth, and continues to have a profound impact on our success. We are determined to have equality in the workplace, within our team and as an extension of our clients’ team.

BLEND360 is an equal opportunity employer.

Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients.

Overview

What We Do

We calm the confusion of IT by guiding the connection between people and technology. If a customer is looking for a better way to manage their warehouse inventory, equip their workforce, or secure their data, we make it happen. All it takes is finding the right combination of tech hardware, software, cloud solutions, and support services. That’s what we do. We’re the IT Department’s IT Department.

Who We Are

Our team is made stronger by a multitude of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. It’s what makes Connection unique—what drives us to innovate and create technology solutions that stand apart from the crowd. We’d love for you to be a part of that fabric, to share your ideas and experiences with a team that thrives on fresh thinking, creativity, and helping others.

Why You Should Join Us

You’ll find supportive teammates and a rewarding career at Connection—plus great benefits. We take pride in supporting employees with a total rewards package that provides financial, emotional, and physical resources for you and your family. Our compensation, 401k plans, medical insurance, and other benefits are progressive and competitive. We value the importance of our employees’ emotional wellbeing. To support employees, we provide free therapy visits, mental health coaching and tools, and meditation resources. You’ll also enjoy a generous paid time off package that includes not only vacation and sick time, but also Wellness and Volunteer Time Off days.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Responsibilities

The Senior Solution Sales Executive (Sr SSE) plays a vital role in driving sales and expanding business opportunities within targeted Federal Agencies across Civilian and DoW. Reporting to the Sr Director of Solution Sales, the Sr SSE operates under general supervision and supports the federal sales team, based in the Washington DC Metro area. The ideal candidate will have previous experience supporting Federal customers, with an understanding of federal requirements such as FedRAMP, CMMC, NDAA & Supply Chain Security, and TAA compliance.

The Senior Solution Sales Executive (Sr SSE) plays a vital role in driving sales and expanding business opportunities within targeted accounts. Reporting to the Sr Director of Solution Sales, the Sr SSE operates under general supervision and supports all sales segments.

As a strategic position, the Sr. SSE proactively engages in complex solution-based conversations at the C-Suite level, aiming to acquire new business for advanced solution sets. These solutions encompass server, storage, networking, cloud, virtualization, cybersecurity and services technologies. The Sr. SSE focuses on driving the adoption of advanced solutions in existing key account relationships and establishes new connections to generate business in assigned accounts.

The primary objective of the Sr. SSE is to meet or exceed revenue and GP targets by executing account strategies that drive positive client business outcomes. This is achieved through a strategic and consultative approach, leveraging existing relationships while establishing new ones with the client and strategic business partners and vendors. By doing so, the Sr. SSE contributes to the growth of key/focus accounts for Connection.

In addition to revenue generation, the Sr. SSE engages in various key initiatives to maximize client satisfaction and business success. These include delivering Connection's value proposition, conducting Quarterly Business Reviews, working on strategic project plans, providing updates on new offerings and services, and serving as a trusted advisor to clients and account managers. The Sr. SSE also presents to various organizational levels, ranging from managers to C-Levels, and represents Connection at customer and vendor events when requested.

  • Knowledgeable on Datacenter Technology and solutions including networking, servers, storage, virtualization, cloud and Connection services offerings (Managed, Professional, and Consulting).

raw.description:
Agentplace is building an AI-native workspace where teams create and work with AI agents. Unlike competitors, we’re focused on agents from day one, and we’re building a full business suite, not just another no-code tool. Based in San Francisco, featured in VentureBeat, USA Today, and Fast Company.

We’re looking for a hands-on GTM Engineer who turns market attention into distribution and users. This isn’t generic marketing. We want someone who understands GTM better than the founder, has a feel for the audience, and brings new ideas instead of waiting for instructions. The role focuses on two channels: content (the main focus) and Generative Search Optimization (GSO), getting Agentplace into answers from AI search and LLMs. You’ll work closely with the founder and product team and own both strategy and execution.

What you’ll do: spot emerging market narratives and turn them into content and clear use cases; run daily distribution on LinkedIn, X, and other channels; publish posts, demos, threads, and short videos; help grow GSO together with the person leading it, adapt content for AI search and LLM answers, and measure visibility; constantly test messages, hooks, and narratives, and run growth experiments on landing pages, content, and channels.

What we’re looking for: a strong hands-on approach and focus on results; deep GTM expertise and your own ideas; a feel for the audience and narratives that hook; experience running content distribution for a startup or product; understanding of GSO as a channel; ability to turn product features into clear stories; an experiment-driven approach and comfort with fast iteration. Nice to have: experience in AI, developer tools, or SaaS; a track record of growing an audience on LinkedIn, X, or YouTube; ability to make simple product demos or short videos.

Details: remote, contract. Compensation from $3,500/month.

How to apply: complete a test task. There’s no time limit. We care about the result, not how long it took. 1) Product: sign up at agentplace.io, build an AI agent for any niche, and publish it as public. Use the Luna model, it’s free. 2) Content: create a mini launch for your agent: a LinkedIn post, an X thread, a demo video up to 60 seconds, and three alternative hooks for the post. 3) GSO: ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude three questions where Agentplace should show up in the answer. Note who appears instead of us and suggest what content would get Agentplace into those answers. Send the link to your agent, your content, the video, and your GSO findings to .

Applications are reviewed by email only. Applications without the completed test task will not be considered. We review applications quickly and will reach out to successful candidates with an offer.

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We are seeking an experienced IT Operations Specialist to help support our team members with IT related tasks and help ensure the Security of our organization.

The IT Team is 100% distributed and remote. This role will be reporting directly to the IT Operations Manager.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Own IT support end-to-end—be the reliable go-to for staff, while turning recurring issues into durable fixes and automations
  • Diagnose and resolve complex cross-platform problems across macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Partner with HR and Security on scalable onboarding and offboarding (access, devices, and lifecycle)
  • Administer MDM platforms (e.g. Jamf, Intune)—including BYOD—harden posture, and improve enrollment and compliance workflows
  • Own patch management: test, validate, and roll out updates safely across the fleet
  • Deploy and secure endpoints and SaaS access in a Zero Trust environment—tighten controls without blocking the business
  • Build and improve automations (scripting, APIs, tools like n8n) for provisioning, access, inventory, and ops workflows
  • Manage device setup, software deployment, hardware shipping/receiving, and the firm’s IT asset inventory
  • Support change management and procurement; collaborate on cloud/IaC-related IT changes where needed
  • Train staff on IT topics and contribute to continuous improvement of systems, docs, and processes
  • Participate in weekend on-call (round-robin) and after-hours response as needed
  • Other related duties as required

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • Excited about Alpaca’s mission and what we’re building
  • 6+ years in IT operations / systems engineering—you’ve owned, hardened, and improved systems, not just answered tickets
  • Proven solutions builder: reverse-engineers complex issues, ships durable fixes, and continuously improves what you own
  • Strong across macOS, Windows, and Linux, including device lifecycle
  • Hands-on with at least two MDM solutions of the following: Jamf, Kandji, Intune, or comparable enterprise MDM
  • Proven patch management experience—including testing, validation, and controlled rollout—not just pushing updates
  • Experience with Google Workspace, 1Password, enterprise SaaS admin, EDR, and SSO / identity workflows
  • Understands Zero Trust environments with good networking concepts to harden access and endpoints without constraining the business
  • Builds and improves automations (scripting, APIs, workflow tools such as n8n); working fluency in at least two programming/scripting languages
  • Hands-on with cloud (GCP and/or AWS) and IaC (e.g. Terraform)—comfortable in IaC-first environments
  • Self-starter and fast responder in a fast-paced environment; clear communicator and team player across the IT team and other teams (business partners)
  • Based for Eastern Time coverage; available for weekend on-call (round-robin rotation across the team)
  • Fluent English (written and verbal); strong analytical and collaborative skills
  • ATeam player with ownership mentality

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field
  • IT, security, or cloud certifications
  • Prior ownership of IT automation platforms, workflow tooling, or internal ops repos
  • Experience designing scalable onboarding / access / offboarding automation
  • Background in fintech or other regulated industries; familiarity with financial and privacy controls
  • Business acumen to balance stakeholder urgency, security risk, feasibility, and budget

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

raw.description:
Agentplace is a platform for building AI agents that serve customers: they answer questions, book appointments, handle customer service, and deliver services online. Based in San Francisco, featured in VentureBeat, USA Today, and Fast Company.

AI agents are a new kind of interface: part chat, part website, part product. We’re looking for an Agentic UX Designer to shape how people build agents on Agentplace and how customers talk to those agents. You’ll work on both sides: the builder experience on our platform and the end-customer experience inside the agents. Freelancers and solo studios welcome: keep your own clients and work with us on a contract basis.

What you’ll do: audit and improve the Agentplace builder (onboarding, agent creation, publishing); design conversation flows: how an agent greets, asks questions, recommends, and hands off to booking or payment; design agent interfaces: chat, cards, forms, and the moments where conversation meets UI; turn user feedback and analytics into clear, testable design changes; create templates and patterns that make every agent on the platform look and feel great.

Who you are: a product or UX designer who is curious about AI and wants to design for what comes after the classic website. You might be a product or UX/UI designer working in Figma, a conversational or chatbot designer, a web designer who builds in Framer or Webflow, a designer who prototypes with AI tools like Cursor, Lovable, or v0, or a freelancer who designs websites and chatbots for clients. Bonus if you’ve designed for chat interfaces, voice assistants, or AI products.

Details: remote, contract, flexible hours. Compensation from $2,500/month.

How to apply: complete a short test task. There’s no time limit. We care about the result, not how long it took. 1) Sign up at and explore the platform. 2) Suggest 3-5 UI improvements. For each one: what’s wrong, how you’d fix it, and why it’s better. Send your improvements as screenshots, a short Figma file, or a Loom video to .

Applications are reviewed by email only. Applications without your UI suggestions will not be considered. We review applications quickly and will reach out to successful candidates with an offer. The best ideas may make it into the product.

Crum & Forster (C&F) provides market leading property & casualty, accident & health, specialty and standard commercial lines insurance solutions. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best.

Our most valuable asset is our people. We have 3000 employees, and locations throughout the United States and India. With our employee-first focus, the Company is consistently recognized as a great place to work, earning multiple workplace and wellness awards, including the Great Place to Work® Award, Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For, Fortune Best Workplaces for Parents, Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials, and many others.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings. For more information about C&F, please visit our website: www.cfins.com

C&F’s Commercial Lines division delivers specialized insurance solutions for mid-sized and large businesses across a broad range of commercial exposures, management liabilities, and industry segments.

Our portfolio includes tailored coverage solutions for General Liability, Commercial Auto, Workers’ Compensation, Property, and Excess Liability, as well as Financial Lines products such as Management Liability, Professional Liability, Cyber, Crime, and Fidelity.

With more than 700 employees across the United States, Commercial Lines combines deep underwriting expertise, disciplined risk selection, and the strength of C&F’s national platform. We work closely with our customers and distribution partners to provide responsive service, thoughtful risk solutions, and the confidence to navigate complex business challenges.

Senior/Executive Underwriter Job Summary - Remote position anywhere in Continental US.

The Middle Market Solutions department at Crum & Forster is looking to scale growth and achieve larger market share in the P&C space. With almost a decade of growth, a strong core team backed by a unique no-ego, entrepreneurial culture, and a book and regional footprint well established, we are now looking to expand our team. This role housed under the home office, will work cohesively with regional management teams to underwrite complex casualty opportunities generated out of the various regions by the regional underwriters. We are seeking an experienced underwriter with market facing background and an entrepreneurial spirit to join our quest for the next level of profitable growth. This individual will be a team player working collaboratively with regional production underwriters to build our large complex casualty book (guaranteed cost and deductibles less than $100k) while directly working with the regional brokers. They will review and analyze underwriting data to select superior risks and build/maintain a profitable book of business with target broker shops by working on their complex/large casualty accounts. They will develop and manage agency relationships through superior customer service, and innovation. They will collaborate with colleagues and maintain strong relationships internally and externally to achieve book profitability and growth goals.   • Ability to work on accounts with collateral and understands both guaranteed cost and deductible/self insured retention structures.
  • Strong attention to detail and a strong mix of analytical and people skills .
  • Make independent decisions within underwriting letter of authority and maintain proper file documentation.
  • Underwrite Auto, General Liability, Workers Compensation and Excess lines of business for a variety of complex Middle Market risks.
  • Actively seek out large business growth opportunities with regional brokers
  • Have in-depth knowledge of department products, services and processes
  • Participate in training and initiatives to develop knowledge base. May participate in projects.
  • Travel may be required on occasion.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Recommended Education & Requirements

· Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and 6+ years of underwriting experience.

· Strong technical casualty lines underwriting expertise

· Knowledge of alternate rating tools a plus

· Strong market facing experience

· Innovative and entrepreneurial spirit and a flexible, dynamic approach to the business willing to embrace the forward looking AI assisted underwriting environment

The Manager, Statistical Programming provides leadership and oversight for a global team of Statistical Programmers, ensuring the delivery of high-quality work that meets established timelines, budget expectations, industry standards, and internal processes. This role is accountable for managing and coordinating statistical programming activities across clinical development projects, including the creation and review of SDTM datasets, ADaM datasets, Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs). In addition, the role is responsible for coaching, mentoring, and developing team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and excellence.

The Manager also contributes to departmental process improvements, standards development, and strategic initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and quality. Through effective leadership and partnership, this position supports the achievement of company, departmental, and functional objectives while driving successful project outcomes.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Manages a team of Statistical Programmers
    • Oversees project activity including aspects of quality, budget, and timelines
    • Ensures that all work for relevant studies is resourced appropriately
    • Provides continual feedback and development support for all team members
    • Supports the growth and development of all members of the Statistical Programming function
    • Participates in relevant performance management activities including review, development, and problem mitigation
    • Participates in the review and assessment of new team members
  • Develops best practices to achieve Statistical Programming department goals
    • Contributes to the review and development of controlled documents
    • Maintains robust knowledge of industry expectations and best practices
    • Identifies any potential issues within the department and works with senior leadership to resolve them
    • Oversees a portfolio of studies with Statistical Programming activities to ensure all work is completed on time, within budget, and meeting or exceeding client expectations.
  • Supports Operational Excellence
    • Acts as a senior reviewer and support for Statistical Programming work performed
    • As needed, leads and/or supports the creation of client deliverables with an emphasis on large, complex, or other high priority opportunities
    • Supports the creation of templates, reusable text, or other work products that may support future work by improving quality and/or reducing cost/effort.
  • Represents Statistical Programming to internal senior leadership and/or to external organizations (e.g., audits, bid defenses, conferences, etc.) regarding topics of performance, quality, goals, and other relevant topics.
  • Supports the Director, Biostatistics on topics related to corporate goals, department development, industry trends, and other relevant topics.

In addition to the above:

  • Leads special projects or initiatives to help improve the efficiency, profitability, or operational excellence of the department. Develops clear goals and expectations for the team
  • Aids in the development of the Statistical Programming team including hiring strategies
  • Responsible for project financials of studies lead by direct reports
  • Plan and coordinate the statistical programming in the support of integration work for regulatory submissions
  • Interacts with applicable internal teams to provide a high standard of consultation on issues related to the statistical programming of clinical trials in a variety of therapeutic areas
  • Support the Biostatistics Director or equivalent with departmental wide resource forecasts and planning
  • Support the Biostatistics Director or equivalent in maintaining metrics and KPIs.

Bachelor’s degree (or Higher) in mathematics, statistics, biostatistics, computer science, or other related disciplines, with 10+ years’ experience in Statistical Programming (SAS and R), preferably in a CRO.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

#LI Remote

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

As a Sr AI Architect, you will lead the company as the Distinguished Engineer and AI Contextual Engineering SME, serving as the guiding authority to our Architects, driving company-wide impact, and steering Twilio's overarching technical direction for conversational AI. In this pivotal leadership role, you will also influence the design and evolution of our company-wide ML/AI Ops foundation. You will set the long-term technical vision, establish architectural guardrails, and ensure strict adherence to responsible AI principles. By driving cross-organizational initiatives and solving complex technical challenges, you will elevate the technical standards across all of Twilio. Transitioning AI/ML concepts from cutting-edge research to resilient, compliant, and cost-effective production systems will be your core mission.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Define and drive a long-term AI/ML architectural vision that aligns with Twilio’s business goals, specifically focusing on how data and memory power the next generation of customer engagement.
  • Own the strategic roadmap for Twilio’s ML/AI Ops platform and tooling, ensuring a unified approach to model development, deployment, and lifecycle management across all platform capabilities.
  • Evaluate and implement modern LLM architectures, RAG systems, MCP/tooling frameworks, and inference optimization techniques.
  • Lead architecture for agentic AI systems including orchestration, reasoning, tool usage, and contextual grounding.
  • Stay current with rapidly evolving advancements in LLMs, agent frameworks, reasoning systems, and AI infrastructure.
  • Transition seamlessly from high-level strategic communication with executives to deep-dive code reviews and pair programming with engineers.
  • Partner closely with Product Management to turn a roadmap into a sequence of technical milestones, ensuring that technical investments always map to customer value.
  • Have a 'player-coach' mentality, and contribute hands-on technical expertise while providing strategic direction and mentorship to the team.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 6+ years specifically focused on building and scaling production-grade ML systems at a platform level.
  • Extensive experience with ML Ops and LLM Ops patterns, including designing and implementing rigorous evaluation metrics, automated retraining loops, and monitoring for non-deterministic AI features at scale.
  • Deep expertise in the design, architecture, and deployment of production-grade ML/AI systems, including deep knowledge of transformer models, LLM orchestration, embedding models, inference optimization and vector stores.
  • Deep understanding of the Context Engineering lifecycle, including semantic retrieval, contextual compression, state management across multi-turn conversations.
  • Strong background in building cloud-based services using AWS, GCP, or Azure, with experience managing high-volume data and various data stores.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to mentor engineers, influence company wide technical strategy, product direction, and drive results across the company.
  • A Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative field.

Desired

  • A track record of relevant publications at top ML conferences or significant open-source contributions.
  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks that specifically measure context quality
  • Track record of designing and implementing enterprise-scale ML/AI Ops platforms
  • Experience working in a geographically distributed environment.

  4. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an emphasis on clarity and technical accuracy.
  5. Commitment to customer service and effective collaboration in a remote environment.
  6. Prior experience with AI training, model evaluation, or content review is a plus.

raw.excerpt: OverviewLMI is seeking an Agile Coach / Trainer Level IV level to strengthen Agile delivery practices and Atlassian tool proficiency across Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) teams and a geographically distributed workforce.
raw.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking an Agile Coach / Trainer Level IV level to strengthen Agile delivery practices and Atlassian tool proficiency across Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) teams and a geographically distributed workforce. This role blends team assessment, practical coaching, interactive instruction, and sustainable adoption strategies to help organizations use Agile methods and Jira more effectively.

The Agile Coach / Trainer will assess current team practices, lead instructor-led and virtual workshops, and coach Scrum Masters, Product Owners, delivery teams, and managers through changes in planning, backlog management, ceremonies, flow, and reporting. Working with instructional designers and analysts, the coach will tailor instruction and follow-up support to demonstrated readiness rather than assume a one-size-fits-all curriculum.

This is not a classroom-only position. Success requires observing actual team behavior, helping teams remove practical barriers, reinforcing skills after training, and building communities that can sustain improvement independently. The ideal candidate can balance common enterprise standards with respect for different team missions and operating contexts.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct Agile maturity, Jira Cloud proficiency, and team-readiness interviews, workshops, and observations.
  • Deliver engaging instructor-led and virtual training on Agile fundamentals for: Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and Jira and Confluence Cloud users.
  • Coach teams on backlogs, ceremonies, prioritization, flow, metrics, and standardized Jira work management.
  • Adapt coaching to assessed team needs; provide office hours and post-training reinforcement.
  • Facilitate Agile communities of practice and champions sessions; gather feedback and improve reusable guidance.
  • Partner with instructional designers and analysts to align training paths with assessment results and adoption measures.
  • Re-assess Agile maturity and Jira Cloud utilization through structured interviews, team observation, facilitated workshops, and evidence-based coaching plans.
  • Tailor role-based coaching for Scrum Masters, Product Owners, team leads, and portfolio stakeholders, with actionable follow-up goals and clear ownership.
  • Demonstrate working Jira boards, epics, stories, sprint and Kanban configurations, dashboards, and reporting approaches during hands-on learning sessions.
  • Measure coaching effectiveness through behavior changes, self-assessments, training feedback, and changes in team practices rather than attendance alone.
  • Create reusable facilitation guides and coach-the-coach material that enable local champions to reinforce skills after formal instruction.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in education, organizational development, business administration, information systems, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant Agile delivery, coaching, training, or transformation experience, including at least 3 years of Agile coaching or instruction.
  • One of the following or equivalent credentials: International Consortium for Agile (ICAgile) Certified Professional in Agile Coaching or Authorized Instructor Credential, Certified Scrum Professional (CSP), Certified Scrum Trainer (CST), Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Practice Consultant (SPC) or Release Train Engineer (RTE).
  • Hands-on Jira Cloud proficiency and practical mastery of Scrum and Agile team practices.
  • Strong virtual facilitation, coaching, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination and satisfy applicable federal personnel vetting, security, privacy, accessibility, and data-handling requirements.
  • Ability to adapt Agile instruction to adult learners with varied technical experience and to facilitate constructive conversations with skeptical / change resistant / change-fatigued teams.
  • Experience defining practical measures of team maturity, coaching progress, and adoption with supporting evidence.

Desired:

  • Prior experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), or federal health programs is highly desirable.
  • Experience establishing Agile communities of practice and scaled coaching models.
  • Jira Align, Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, or public-sector technology transformation experience.
  • Experience measuring Agile maturity and training effectiveness.
  • Experience connecting scaled portfolio practices with team-level execution and Jira/Jira Align reporting expectations.
  • A master's degree in organizational development, adult learning, instructional technology, or industrial-organizational psychology is desirable.
  • Additional credentials such as ICAgile Agile Team Facilitation (ICP-ATF) or ICAgile Enterprise Agile Coaching are desirable.
  • Atlassian Cloud certifications beneficial

Target Salary Range: $102,000 - $174,000

Disclaimer:

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Keep inventory moving and every order on track. We're looking for an organised, proactive, and detail-driven Supply Chain Coordinator with hands-on NetSuite experience to manage inventory records, purchase orders, order fulfilment, and logistics coordination. If you're confident navigating ERP systems, maintaining accurate inventory data, and coordinating with suppliers and warehouse teams, this could be a great fit.

Work Setup: Fully Remote (US Shift). Onsite schedules upon client request.

Role Overview

As our Supply Chain Coordinator, you'll support day-to-day supply chain operations across inventory management, procurement, order processing, and freight logistics. You'll take ownership of maintaining accurate records in NetSuite, coordinating with third-party logistics (3PL) providers, and ensuring smooth order and shipment fulfilment.

Key Responsibilities

NetSuite Administration & Inventory Management

  • Maintain Inventory Records: Keep NetSuite updated with accurate inventory, purchase orders, sales orders, and product records.

  • Manage Inventory Transactions: Process stock adjustments, inventory receipts, and assembly completions in NetSuite.

  • Reconcile Inventory: Regularly compare inventory records across NetSuite, Shopify, and 3PL warehouse systems, identifying and resolving discrepancies.

  • Track Product Details: Maintain SKU, UPC, and part number records, including batch/lot numbers, shelf life, and expiration dates.

Procurement & Vendor Coordination

  • Manage Purchase Orders: Create and issue POs in NetSuite based on reorder points and management instructions.

  • Monitor Supplier Updates: Record vendor confirmations, lead times, and estimated delivery dates.

  • Verify Purchasing Records: Match purchase orders against receiving documents and vendor invoices, flagging discrepancies for review.

  • Maintain Production Records: Track manufacturing dates, quantities, batch/lot numbers, and certificates of analysis (COAs).

3PL & Freight Logistics

  • Coordinate Warehouse Operations: Work closely with 3PL teams to ensure accurate inventory receipts, order updates, and shipment records.

  • Manage Freight Bookings: Arrange routine freight shipments, track deliveries, and maintain shipment logs.

  • Support Marketplace Shipments: Coordinate inbound shipments to online marketplaces as required.

  • Maintain Shipping Documentation: Organise bills of lading, packing slips, and proof of delivery records.

  • Handle Delivery Issues: Document and raise claims for damaged, missing, or incorrectly delivered goods.

Skills & Experience

  • Critical: At least 1 year of hands-on, daily NetSuite ERP experience, particularly in creating and managing purchase orders, sales orders, inventory adjustments, and item records.

  • Highly Desirable: Previous supply chain, logistics, or order management experience within the consumer goods, beauty, hair care, or e-commerce industry.

  • Systems Experience: Familiarity with Shopify, 3PL/WMS platforms, and Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including VLOOKUPs, filters, and basic formulas.

  • Operational Strengths: Strong attention to detail, organisation, prioritisation, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with confidence coordinating with suppliers, warehouse teams, and internal stakeholders.

  • Working Style: Proactive, dependable, and execution-driven, with the ability to work independently in a remote setup and consistently follow through on deliverables.

What’s in It for You

  • Recognised by Great Place To Work:Ranked #8 Best Workplace in the Philippines and #3 Best Workplace in IT-BPM in the Medium category for 2026.

  • Work That Fits Real Life:Roles aligned with Australian and US clients, with day and night shift options plus WFH, hybrid and office-based setups depending on the role.

  • Room to Grow:Structured onboarding and ongoing Learning & Development programs that help employees build skills, strengthen capability and prepare for broader responsibilities.

  • Health Cover From Day 1:Health insurance coverage from Day 1 plus dependent coverage, giving employees and their families added peace of mind from the start.

  • Clear Pay, Clear Expectations:Compensation aligned with the role and experience, supported by clear responsibilities and expectations from the outset.

  • Work That Connects You to the Client:Work directly with international businesses as part of a dedicated team that operates as an extension of their business.

  • Support Beyond Day 1: Our People & Culture and support teams stay involved beyond onboarding, providing day-to-day guidance, employee support, engagement and recognition throughout the employee experience.

Plus the everyday extras: Modern workspaces, complimentary onsite meals, flowing coffee and drinks at our café bar, additional time off and tenure incentives.

About Us
At hammerjack, we connect skilled professionals in the Philippines with growing businesses across Australia and beyond—building teams that work as true extensions of our clients. We're proud to be named among the Fortune 100 Best Workplaces in Southeast Asia and ranked the 8th Best Workplace in the Philippines.

Our Impact
Our people aren't outsourced—they're embedded. With aligned tools, shared goals, and real accountability, they deliver at the same standard and pace as onshore teams while building long-term careers they're proud of, across accounting, tech, admin, and marketing.

Do you have end to end project experience in a Mobile First Product Company?

Do you have experience leading a backend team and with an OOP language?

Great! Please read on as we have a role for you.

Join a profitable, fast-moving mobile apps startup as a Backend Lead, where you’ll own the core backend behind social and dating products used by hundreds of thousands of users. You’ll lead a senior team of 4–5 backend engineers, reporting directly to the CEO, and be responsible for turning product and business goals into clear technical roadmaps, sprint plans, and high-quality execution. Your work will be a mix of hands-on leadership and coding in a fully remote, international environment.

On the technical side, you’ll take charge of a high-traffic Ruby on Rails platform and power ongoing feature development while modernising the architecture. You’ll lead key initiatives such as improving performance and reliability, introducing better caching and data flows, and supporting real-time features at scale on AWS. You’ll be the one making and documenting critical technical decisions, ensuring smooth deployments and stable APIs, and stepping in when needed to debug complex production issues, all with the goal of turning a good backend into a high-output, well-organised machine.

This is a fully remote B2B contract opportunity with a base salary that goes up to $120,000 USD per year

Your Tasks Will Include:

  • Lead and mentor a team of mid/senior backend engineers (4–5), including 1:1s, feedback, and performance management
  • Translate product and business goals into clear technical roadmaps, sprint plans, and backend priorities
  • Own the backend architecture and technical vision for mobile-first, consumer-facing apps used by tens of thousands of daily active users
  • Drive and oversee implementation of new features for our mobile apps, working closely with iOS/Android, Product, Data, DevOps and Trust & Safety teams
  • Take key architectural decisions around scalability, performance, reliability, data flows, and infrastructure on AWS
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, improve API speed and reliability, and design effective caching and database strategies
  • Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, coding standards, code review practices, and deployment/CI pipelines
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation and design specs for backend systems and major initiatives
  • Handle prioritisation and trade-offs in a fast-moving environment with changing quarterly priorities
  • Be hands-on with coding and code reviews, especially for complex or high-impact areas, and step in during critical production incidents

To be a good fit for the Lead Backend Engineer role:

  • 8+ years of professional backend development experience in production environments and most recent experience in leading a backend teams
  • Proven experience owning backend architecture for a mobile-first, consumer-facing app
  • Strong hands-on expertise with any OOP language - Ruby, Java, PHP, Python, C# (must be willing to work with Ruby on Rails)
